Description:

Pilatus is hiring a Procurement Manager to join our team in Sarasota, FL. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining supplier performance in accordance with agreed contractual terms and real-time business needs. Pilatus is a global company based in Switzerland with a worldwide supplier base and this position is focused on the suppliers located in North America. The primary focus is resolution of issues that require face-to-face onsite presence, on short notice and over an extended period of time. The position is expected to be forward-thinking and to recommend and implement strategies for improving supplier performance and meeting production and customer support requirements. Take your career to the next level with Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.

* Assists with proactive and successful management of assigned suppliers within the North American supplier portfolio
* Hold suppliers accountable to contractual obligations, commitments, and Key Performance Indicators
* Solves crisis and secures execution of recovery plans.
* Perform supplier risk analysis, develop and execute mitigation actions that protects Pilatus’s production plan
* Communicate proactively with all Pilatus supply chain stakeholders
* Escalate issues when needed according to roles and responsibilities
* Travel on short notice for in-person supplier visits as required
* Support ongoing supplier management tasks
* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and the procurement team in Switzerland
* Collaborate with internal departments and stakeholders, including leading projects and meetings
* Support tracking of supply chain KPIs
* Participate actively in the improvement of procurement processes and management of cross-divisional projects
* Participate in special projects as required
* Act as liaison for procurement activities in European and North American Pilatus offices

Requirements:

**Skills/Qualifications**

* Minimum B.S. in Supply Chain Management or equivalent; graduate degree is an advantage
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a supply chain and/or procurement role in the aircraft industry
* Experience with business intelligence tools and supply chain analytics
* Willingness and ability to travel both domestically and internationally, sometimes on short notice
* Ability to develop relationships and interact effectively with both internal and external stakeholders across varied business areas
* Good knowledge in lean principles and tools
* Experience with ERP/MRP software
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibilities.

The hiring range is $68,000 - $94,000 per year. This range represents Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd.’s estimate of the compensation reasonably expected for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant skills and experience, education, job location, internal equity, market data, and business considerations. The hiring range may be modified in the future based on business or market conditions. Any bonus, incentive compensation, benefits, or other forms of compensation are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans, programs, and policies and may be modified in accordance with applicable law.

Interested and qualified candidates should submit their application as soon as possible. Please note that this announcement may close at any time; early applications are encouraged.

With over 3,000 employees and about 200 apprentices at its headquarters in Stans, Switzerland, completion center in Broomfield, Colorado, and multiple service centers across Westminster, MD, Rock Hill, SC, Chamblee, GA and Sarasota, FL, the Pilatus family unites people from over 40 countries. We offer a secure, innovative, international, and sustainable work environment. Courage, vision, and outstanding performance have made us a strong company. Our culture is shaped by a high level of quality awareness, close customer relationships, and a high degree of employee commitment.

Pilatus Aircraft USA Ltd. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Technical Buyer - Electric Motors

**Department:** Purchasing

**Location:** FEDCO Headquarters, Monroe, Michigan

**Employment Status:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Reports To:** Supply Chain Manager

**Position Summary**
====================

The Technical Buyer - Electric Motors sources and manages electric motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and related components for FEDCO products and customer projects. This purchasing role requires the technical knowledge to evaluate requirements, compare proposals, identify specification gaps, and coordinate questions with Engineering, Sales, Quality, and suppliers.

The position owns quotations, purchase orders, pricing, delivery performance, negotiations, and supplier relationships while balancing cost, quality, lead time, compliance, and customer requirements.

**Essential Responsibilities**
==============================

**Purchasing and Order Execution**
----------------------------------

* Request, evaluate, and compare supplier quotations for motors, VFDs, accessories, and related components.
* Create and manage purchase orders; verify pricing, quantities, specifications, documentation, and delivery dates.
* Resolve supplier acknowledgement discrepancies involving configuration, price, lead time, freight, warranty, or terms.
* Monitor open orders and delivery commitments; escalate risks and drive recovery actions.
* Maintain accurate ERP data and coordinate expedites, changes, cancellations, returns, warranty claims, and corrective actions.

**Technical Motor Purchasing**
------------------------------

* Review motor data sheets, drawings, customer specifications, and application requirements to confirm the required configuration.
* Compare ratings, voltage, frequency, speed, frame, enclosure, efficiency, mounting, duty, hazardous-area requirements, and accessories.
* Identify exceptions or missing information and coordinate approvals with Engineering, Sales, Quality, customers, and suppliers.
* Confirm NEMA or IEC construction, regional electrical requirements, and certifications; support motor and VFD sourcing without assuming final design authority.

**Supplier Sourcing and Commercial Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain qualified domestic and global sources for standard and engineered motor requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, payment terms, freight, warranties, minimum quantities, stocking arrangements, and supply agreements.
* Evaluate total landed cost, including freight, tariffs, duties, quality risk, lead time, and inventory impact.
* Support supplier qualification and performance reviews; track quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost, technical support, market conditions, and supply risks.

**Cross-Functional Support and Improvement**
--------------------------------------------

* Partner with Planning and Operations on forecasts, inventory, shortages, and project priorities.
* Support product development, engineering changes, value analysis, standardization, and cost reduction.
* Provide motor pricing, lead-time, sourcing, and technical information for quotations and customer orders.
* Maintain supplier records and reports, comply with purchasing, quality, and trade requirements, and perform other duties as assigned.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

Success in this role may be evaluated through:

* Supplier quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost control, and technical support.
* Accuracy of sourcing decisions, purchase orders, documentation, and supplier commitments.
* Cost savings, risk avoidance, timely support, clear communication, organized records, and follow-through.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent technical training and relevant experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of purchasing, sourcing, or supplier-management experience involving electric motors, drives, rotating equipment, or industrial electrical components.
* Experience buying three-phase induction motors, working with manufacturers or distributors, developing requests for quotation, comparing proposals, negotiating terms, and managing orders through delivery.
* International sourcing, landed-cost analysis, and engineered-to-order manufacturing experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems, purchasing controls, Microsoft Office, and relevant motor certifications.
* Professional purchasing certification is a plus; ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

*FEDCO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.*

The pay range is $73,000.00 - $132,000.00

Pay is based on several factors which vary based on position. These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications. In addition to your pay, Target cares about and invests in you as a team member, so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Target offers eligible team members and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which may include medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more, to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits for eligible team members include 401(k), employee discount, short term disability, long term disability, paid sick leave, paid national holidays, and paid vacation. Find competitive benefits from financial and education to well-being and beyond at https://corporate.target.com/careers/benefits.

**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

A role in Buying means working with several diverse vendors to choose the best product mix, both in-store and online. We help determine where to localize, while calibrating market positioning and acting as brand managers. Here, you’ll own a wide SKU count so that your work is varied and challenging. Through cross-functional collaboration, instinct and creativity, you will be the expert on the guest, the market and the competition.

A **Buyer** helps create omni-channel growth by planning profitable and locally relevant assortments using your grasp of guest shopping behavior, assortment requirements and competitors. You will influence and negotiate with vendors to achieve results and identify gaps and opportunities. Your flexibility in reacting to business results and your ability to translate financial metrics and data into actionable strategies will be critical. You will lead cross-functional teams to drive category results while managing progress toward sales and margin goals. Your partnerships with product designers and/or category managers and vendors will help guide product development as you source appropriately for your category. You will interact with Associate Buyers, Senior Merchandise Specialists, the Pricing and Promotion Center of Excellence, Planning, Site Merchandising, the Item Center of Excellence and many other expert partners in support of your promotional planning work across channels.

Core responsibilities are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience
* 1+ years of Merchandising experience
* Strong strategic and analytical skills to grow a business
* Strong collaboration skills to partner with Cross Functional Teams
* Flexibility, resilient and comfortable working in “grey areas” that are constantly changing

This position will operate as a Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement based on Target’s needs. A Hybrid/Flex for Your Day work arrangement means the team member’s core role will need to be performed both onsite at the Target HQ MN location the role is assigned to and virtually, depending upon what your role, team and tasks require for that day. Work duties cannot be performed outside of the country of the primary work location, unless otherwise prescribed by Target. Click here if you are curious to learn more about Minnesota.

**Benefits Eligibility**

Please paste this url into your preferred browser to learn about benefits eligibility for this role: https://tgt.biz/BenefitsForYou\\_D

**Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)**

In compliance with state and federal laws, Target will make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please reach out to candidate.accommodations@HRHelp.Target.com. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed through this channel.

Application deadline is : 10/18/2026

description:
**WORK LOCATION DETAILS**

* **Work Location:** Home Office - Coppell, TX
* **Work Schedule:** Hybrid
* **Onsite:** Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays
* **Work from Home:** Mondays and Fridays

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Associate Buyer (Floral) is responsible for creating and executing merchandise strategies in partnership with the Buyer/Sr. Buyer to deliver Product Proud assortments to meet or exceed sales, margin and turn requirements. This Includes assortment selection & management, product development and go to market efforts (includes marketing, in store visual etc.). In addition, the Associate Buyer partners with key functional peers including Planner, Sourcing Managers and Visual Team to implement strategies maximizing business opportunities pre-season, during season and post-season.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* **Merchandising Strategy and Product Development**

* Develop and execute merchandise strategies in partnership with Buyer/Sr. Buyer; Includes assortment management and customer facing visual and storytelling ideas

* Responsible for supporting Buyer/ Sr. Buyer in Product Development vision in conjunction with a sourcing manager who administers the processes and timelines

* Travel and time in market for trend identification, category expertise and white space opportunities.

* **Vendor Relationships**

* Work with National Brand product partners to understand the market, the category, and to carefully curate assortments leveraging their expertise.

* In partnership with sourcing, who manages the vendor matrix, maintain relationships with key private label product partners to deliver product proud assortments, collaboratively drive business results and represent the At Home brand professionally in the market.

* **Financial Planning, Data Analysis, Inventory & Reporting**

* Provide insights and actively participate in the OTB process to drive category P&L in collaboration with the Sr. Buyer/ Buyer and the Sr. Planner/Planner

* Assist with analyzing purchasing trends, sales data, and supplier performance; Includes recommendations on action to take pre-season, during season and post-season

* Provide a point of view on assortment changes based on market assessment, prediction of purchasing needs, and productivity assessment of sales data

* **Cross-Department Collaboration:**

* Partner with Marketing, Digital and Packaging teams to achieve strategic business objectives and Go to Market vision

* Work closely with planning, sourcing, & visual teams to align Merchandising with company goals.

* Support Buyer/ Sr. Buyer with strategic initiatives and applicable milestone meetings

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is considered.

* 3-5 years’ experience in retail buying/ merchandising, planning, or related experience

* Merchandising or PD experience in (Decor) is a plus but not required.

* Product Development Ability; Creative and innovative skillset

* Ability to identify emerging trends and shops competition and market regularly

* Strong leadership and critical thinking skills

* Ability to develop and maintain strong cross-functional relationships

* Communicates and translates information in a well thought-out, concise, and easy to understand manner in both verbal and written form

* Demonstrates effective organizational skills and good time management

* Willing to travel for market and store trips

* Innate curiosity and passion for product and customer satisfaction

We have many opportunities available on our other career site pages. Click here to link to our careers page!

Signet Jewelers is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry, operating more than 2,800 stores worldwide under the iconic brands: Kay Jewelers, Zales, Jared, H.Samuel, Ernest Jones, Peoples, Banter by Piercing Pagoda, Rocksbox, JamesAllen.com and Diamonds Direct. We are a people-first company and this core value is at the heart of everything we do, from empowering our valued team members, to collaborating with our customers, to fostering the communities in which we live and serve. People – and the love their actions inspire – are what drive us. We’re not only proud of the love we inspire outside our walls, we’re especially proud of the diversity, inclusion and equity we’re inspiring inside. There are dynamic career paths awaiting you – rewarding opportunities to impact the lives of others and inspire love. Join us!

Watch Buyer I is responsible for the end-to-end management of the watch category, including assortment planning, product selection, vendor management, inventory maintenance, and promotional strategies. The Watch Buyer I operates with day-to-day ownership of the category while reporting to the Sr. Buyer and partnering closely to develop and execute overall category strategies.

**Category Management**

o Give input as requested to set Strategic Vision for Category

o Ability to adjust quickly, if needed, to changing market trends, conditions, priorities, and corporate strategies.

o Analyze and React to Business on a weekly basis

o Participate in the development of financial plans and advertising/marketing plans for designated product categories.

o Assist in all business reviews for all designated product categories to Leadership.

o Oversee training and career development for Direct Reports / Team

**Assortment Management & Brand/Vendor Management.**

o Select watch merchandise from established brand partners, ensuring assortments align with consumer demand, brand positioning, and strategic department goals.

o Actively manage the watch assortment lifecycle from initial selection and seasonal assortment planning through inventory management, promotional activity, markdowns, and end of life.

o Partner with Senior Buyer to develop and maintain strategic brand assortments, identifying opportunities to expand key brands, styles, collections, and price points based on customer demand and category performance.

o Build and maintain strong relationships with watch brand partners, strategically managing the vendor base to optimize assortment, inventory, pricing, product availability, and overall category performance.

**Collaboration**

o Coordinate efforts with the marketing, visual display and advertising departments to promote and market key items, programs/brands and categories.

o Merchandise all marketing channel items for designated product categories. Present and justify all catalog/promotional items to merchandise directors and vice presidents.

o Participate in management of open-to-buy for assigned product categories with CMT and update as needed.

o When applicable; work directly with Signet’s accounting department to ensure credits/aging are applied correctly.

o Assist CMT with issues on vendor performance, including late orders and quality control issues.

o Proofing of all advertising materials to ensure accuracy including emails, web site and store signage.

o Work in collaboration with Visual Merchandising team for in-store presentations (planograms).

o Work cross-functionally with stores Ops team, VM, DC team and Planning on store test, Rollouts, RTV’s

**Additional Job Description**

Education Required: Bachelor’s Degree in Fashion Merchandising or related field preferred

Required or Acceptable Job-Related Experience: 2+ years’ experience prior buying experience

Years of Job-Related Experience Required: 2+ years

Technical/Other Skills Required:

o Computer skills with knowledge of Microsoft Office/Excel.

o Strong communication skills (both written and verbal), negotiation skills, attention to detail and accuracy, organizational skills, and math skills (ability to work with numbers and analyze data).

o Ability to be metal free and work in a metal free environment, when necessary, is based on security policy.

o Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

o Ability to work independently as well as a team.

o Ability to lead team if applicable.

o Ability to demonstrate leadership skills.

As Buyer, you will be responsible for the overall merchandising strategy and product direction within assigned categories or departments, aiming to meet or exceed sales, margin, and financial objectives. This role focuses on curating the most distinctive and high-quality merchandise that reflects Saks Global’s exceptional standards and aligns with customer needs and preferences. Leveraging competitive intelligence, customer insights, and business analysis, you will ensure a customer-centric assortment that drives performance. In addition to leading the purchasing and negotiation of merchandise, you will partner with Merchandise Planners to develop and execute strategies that maximize business opportunities. As the Buyer, you will also manage and mentor a team of Associate Buyers, Assistant Buyers, and Coordinators, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment with business goals

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

Assortment Strategy

* Provide input on category and pre-season planning strategy in collaboration with Planners based on past performance and knowledge on trends/brand insights, and execute on the strategy throughout the season
* Build customer-centered assortment framework and allocation strategy based on customer and trend insights from Stores, Digital, CACI and Fashion and provide guidelines for allocation teams to follow
* Set strategies for product display and flow (e.g., launch dates, weeks of full-price selling, cross-sell opportunities, collection considerations) in alignment with guardrails from Planning and Marketing

Market Activities

* Lead market prep activities and attend market to select the best product in alignment with guardrails from Planning (e.g., Checkbook, OTB) and category direction from BP & Buying Leads (e.g., omni strategy, banner differentiation)
* Coordinate buys with brand partners, collaborate on exclusive merchandise, manage day-to-day communication around in-season brand performance, trending styles, chase opportunities and resolve escalated order management issues

In-Season Management

* Review daily performance reports and work closely with Planner counterparts to gather insights on trending products, categories, brands, etc., pull in-season levers to optimize performance and prepare for monthly OTB meetings to provide bottoms-up context and escalate opportunities and risks to Leads
* Serve as the owner of their business, constantly negotiating with Brand Partners throughout the season to improve performance (e.g., style swaps, capsules, RTVs, matrix expansion, markdowns)

Leadership Development

* Provide mentorship and hands-on training to Associate Buyers, Assistant Buyers, and Coordinators, equipping them with the business acumen and practical skills needed to become successful future Buyers

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING:**

Required Qualifications (Minimum Requirements):

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent retail experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a buying office with a strong understanding of buying operations and retail strategy.
* Proven business acumen with strong financial, analytical, and strategic planning skills.
* Expertise in retail math, including markup, margin planning, OTB, WOS, T/O, GMROI, and assortment planning.
* Demonstrated leadership and team management capabilities in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong internal and vendor relationships.
* Strong customer focus with a results-driven mindset and ability to manage ambiguity.
* Highly organized with strong planning, prioritization, and conflict management skills.
* Strategic thinker with the agility to adapt to changing business needs.
Willingness to travel, including internationally, as needed.

* Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate

* Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)
* An amazing employee discount

description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The **Buyer** **(Home Organization)** plays a critical role in shaping and executing the category strategy for a designated department. With a strong understanding of product development, pricing architecture, and customer behavior, the Buyer is responsible for building a compelling, brand-right assortment that drives both financial results and customer engagement. This role requires a blend of creativity, analytical skills, and market insight to deliver innovative product stories that differentiate the brand and meet evolving customer expectations.

The ideal candidate is a well-rounded merchant with a passion for products and a strong ability to translate insights into strategy. They will lead cross-functional teams, including Planning, Sourcing, and Go-to-Market partners, ensuring each category reflects a clear vision, a strong value proposition, and meaningful differentiation in the market.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* **Cross-Functional Team Leadership**
Demonstrates the ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams, including individuals who do not report directly. Success in this role requires strong influence, collaboration, and communication skills to foster alignment and drive high performance across diverse teams. The ability to build consensus and lead through influence is a crucial competency for an At-Home Buyer.
* **Category Strategy & Assortment Planning**
Develop and execute customer-focused merchandise strategies and seasonal assortment plans that support financial objectives and reflect brand values.
* Partner with Planning & Sourcing to build season assortment plans; Planning to own input & management of the tool, with support from Buyer on item intent & retail and sourcing for cost confirmation.
* **Product Expertise & Development**
Act as the category product expert, with deep knowledge of quality tiers, construction, pricing, and brand-appropriate product selection. Lead curation of newness and product stories that create customer excitement and drive productivity.
* **Business & Financial Management**
Partner with Planning to build merchandise financial plans and by-door assortments. Manage Open to Buy and take decisive action in-season to achieve sales, margin, and inventory goals.
* **Vendor & Sourcing Collaboration**
Communicate category/item strategy and target expectations to sourcing, ensuring sourcing's ability to negotiate costs, improve margins, and optimize the vendor matrix based on strategic needs of the business. Build and maintain strong relationships with key product partners.
* I **n-Season Performance Optimization**
Analyze weekly, monthly, and seasonal sales data to identify risks and opportunities. React quickly to trends and adjust strategies to maximize profitability.
* **Inventory & Markdown Management**
Collaborate with Planning on assortment intent and season priorities. While planning will manage inventory levels and markdown strategies that balance margin and sell-through, it will be imperative to provide the inputs to ensure strategic goals are met.
* **Market & Competitive Analysis**
Conduct structured competitive shops and gather marketplace intelligence to inform strategy, uncover whitespace, and ensure assortment differentiation.
* **Cross-Functional Execution**
Work closely with Marketing, eCommerce/Digital and Visual Merchandising to ensure cohesive go-to-market execution and alignment on brand and business goals.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience.
* 5-7 years of experience in buying, merchandising, or category management in a retail or consumer-focused organization.
* Strong product sensibility and understanding of pricing, quality, and customer value
* Demonstrated ability to build product assortment and deliver financial results
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
* Passionate about the customer, brand storytelling, and product innovation

**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Procurement Manager, you'll be responsible for managing a team of employees responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and managing service provider for outsourced services. You will also assist a client or department with the development and execution of sourcing and procurement strategies.

This job is part of the Procurement function. They are responsible for sourcing and purchasing goods, services, or raw materials from vendors and suppliers.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Work with business stakeholders, operational shared services team members, and sponsors to develop, coordinate, and execute strategy at local and regional levels.
* Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and maintain contracts and other business documents in support of the purchase of goods and services.
* Review the process of contract terminations, expirations, extensions, and renewals. Inform peers and corporate management staff of changes or results.
* Manage supplier and contractor certification process. Conduct periodic visits to supplier work locations to review vendor performance.
* Mentor and educate on contemporary outsourcing practices and the value of applying them.
* Analyze account-wide facility management services spend, suppliers, operations, and statement of works to identify opportunities for value creation.
* Assist with creating RTFs, selecting solutions, and negotiating. Prepare and maintain contracts with national and regional service providers. Ensure contracts adhere to company standards.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence parties of shared interests to reach an agreement. Deal with sensitive issues.
* Apply knowledge of own discipline and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day-to-day and moderately complex issues which may or may not be evident in existing systems and processes.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. C.P.M., C.P.S.M. or N.A.C.M. certifications or eligibility preferred.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention preferred.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role:

As a Sr Sourcing Deputy, you will play a crucial role in executing procurement processes, managing supplier relationships, and driving cost efficiencies. The focus will be on strategic sourcing and supplier management, including negotiations, contracting, and supplier performance. You will need to collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with company goals and market trends.

Your Contribution:

* Develop and implement sourcing strategies that align with the company’s overall goals and objective

* Gathering and analyzing information about the market, including competitors, customers, trends and products

* Manage sourcing and procurement for electronic components.
* Oversee supplier management and negotiate pricing and contracts.
* Lead new supplier selection and vendor management.
* Responsible for cost negotiations, drive cost reduction strategies and identify sourcing opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal teams to provide market trend analysis; provide supplier roadmap and market trend & analysis to internal customers on regular basis
* Develop and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and partners.
* Ensure business continuity and risk mitigation strategies are in place, work on long term component capacity planning and identifying sourcing bottlenecks

Your Qualifications and Skills:

* At least 6-8 years of sourcing experience, especially in electronic components.
* High proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
* Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work globally across regions (US, EMEA, AP).
* Experience in strategic sourcing and international procurement.
* Ability to understand market drivers and cost structures.
* Strong interpersonal skills for effective collaboration.
* Proven track record in supplier and cost management.
* Knowledge of financial analysis related to sourcing.

Work Location and Model:

At Logitech, we empower global collaboration by providing a flexible hybrid work model. Depending on the role and team needs, this may include working remotely, on-premises, or a blend of both.

This is a hybrid position. The successful candidate is expected to work onsite at our San Jose, CA office 2–3 days per week, with the remaining days remote. Specific onsite days will be coordinated with your manager and team.

Compensation:

This position offers an annual base salary typically between $ 116,000 and $ 152,000 . In certain circumstances, higher compensation will be considered based on the business need, candidate experience, and skills.

Benefits:

Logitech offers benefits such as Medical Coverage, Dental Coverage, Vision Coverage, Traditional and Roth 401(k) Plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP), Basic and Additional Life Insurance, Disability Coverage, Adoption and Surrogacy Assistance, Tuition Reimbursement Plans, Commuter Benefits, Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave, and Paid Parental Leave.

Logitech also offers Wellness Programs, Health Savings Account Plans, access to Expert Medical Opinions, Identity Theft Protection, Breast Milk Delivery to Nursing Mothers on Business Travel, access to a Group Legal Plan, Donations Matching Programs, Employee Product Discounts, and access to Auto, Home, and Pet Insurance.

#LI-SN1

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

All qualified applicants

Description:

Join Amrize as a Project Procurement Manager, Construction and help construct what's next. If you're ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America — we want to hear from you!

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Project Procurement Manager, Construction will oversee all aspects of procurement for the project including for all capital equipment, building materials, construction related services and raw materials. This position will manage supplier relationships, strategic sourcing and procurement processes and ensure the timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials and services essential for the project. The Procurement Manager must utilize a proactive approach to optimizing procurement strategies and place a strong focus on cost reduction, quality assurance and supply chain efficiency.

**WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies that align with the Project’s business goals and operational requirements.
* Lead cross-functional teams to manage procurement projects from initiation through to completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers, vendors, and service providers to secure advantageous terms.
* Conduct market research and supplier evaluations to identify and onboard reliable suppliers and subcontractors.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including engineering, production, logistics, quality assurance, and finance departments, to forecast demand and ensure an uninterrupted supply of materials.
* Monitor and manage supplier performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and performance metrics.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance procurement processes, reduce costs, and improve supplier performance.
* Ensure compliance with procurement activities' legal, regulatory, and environmental policies and standards.
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree
* Field of Study Preferred: Supply Chain Management, business administration, engineering or related field

**Required Work Experience:**

* Minimum 7+ years experience in Procurement or Supply Chain Management, preferably within a construction manufacturing environment and/or a greenfield plant environment.
* Certification in supply chain management or procurement is a plus.
* 7+ years of managing suppier relationships, strategic soucing and handling negotiations

**Required Computer and Software Skills:**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience working with Procore or similar project management software Proficient in procurement software and systems

**Travel Requirements:**

* Occasional, but regular overnight travel to the project site and to suppliers for meetings and presentations

**Additional Requirements:**

* Demonstrate detailed and efficient organization skills
* Demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills
* Work well under pressure to meet project deadlines
* Show high levels of commitment to detail
* Strong knowledge of procurement processes, supply chain management, and strategic sourcing principles.
* Strong knowledge and project procurement experience with greenfield and brownfield expansions.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Must have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing processes and materials.
* Project management skills, including planning, scheduling, and managing budgets.
* Familiarity with capital projects including engineering and construction

description:
We are a team of strategic advisors, architects, and implementers who drive business transformations. Our diverse talent energizes clients' business functions and technology to maximize value in Supply Chain enhancing their ability to fulfill their growth and efficiency ambitions. Imagine working with world-class supply network capabilities like Smart Factory, Strategy & Innovation, Supply Chain Responsiveness, Sourcing & Procurement, or Product Development & Operations!

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? Join our US Supply Chain & Network Operations Offering, where you'll deliver transformational solutions using operational expertise, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions. Don't miss the chance to be part of a team that provides exceptional client value while advancing your professional journey. Apply now and become a vital part of our innovative and dynamic workforce!

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026

**The team**

Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy and value.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

This role utilizes your deep understanding of end-to-end network transformation, with a specific emphasis on strategic sourcing and procurement impacts to broader supply chain design. While below is a sample of the role, each unique project will provide you the opportunity to develop and grow your supply chain transformation capabilities.

* Conduct discussions with senior leaders on functional solutions within sourcing and procurement and network visibility/resiliency
* Lead discussions with business to understand needs and requirements, translating requirements into technical platform functionality, and collaborate with technical architects ensuring technically feasible and scalable technology application solutions
* Perform high-level functional and technical architecture, analysis, research, and design for sourcing and procurement, `network visibility and resiliency/decision intelligence solutions
* Lead project delivery across process design, data analytics, solution configuration, deployment, testing, knowledge management, and performance metric development
* Advise clients on supply chain and operations strategy and translating findings into network design / sourcing strategies, total cost of ownership models, and recommendations for client executives
* Manage multiple workstreams and lead onshore and offshore teams in a client service environment
* Assess category cost drivers, supplier opportunities, and large datasets to identify trends, insights, and cost improvement opportunities
* Promote and participate in forums for sharing expertise, strengthening Deloitte's collective knowledge, and helping to resolve clients' challenges
Collaborate on innovative solutions to bolster the future of the practice

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 8+ years of experience in consulting, industry, or both
* 6+ years of experience leading network design, transformation and/or sourcing and procurement projects from strategy through implementation
* Experience with end-to-end supply chain assessments, spend analytics, network optimization, Request for Proposal (RFP) processes, strategic sourcing execution, category management, operational procurement, demand management, and supplier management
* Experience leading project teams or workstreams
* Experience utilizing and/or implementing relevant technology applications (e.g., Llamasoft, Coupa, Logility, iValua, etc)
* Experience using analytics, metrics and AI-centric tools/agents
* Ability to travel up to 50%, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be authorized to work in the US without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Operations Research, Strategy, Finance, Engineering Management, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or related fields
* Prior Consulting experience
* Relevant software vendor Certifications
* Experience leading a project team in a project client environment.
* Experience developing total cost of ownership models
* Experience with Bill of Materials (BOM) analysis and spend analytics
* Experience with Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) and supplier risk management

**We are Driven to Deliver:**

* Competitive pay and benefits, including Day 1 Health & Wellness Benefits, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, 401K Employer Matching, Education Assistance, Paid Time Off, and much more.
* Growth opportunities performing essential work to support America’s food service and broadline distribution system.
* Safe and inclusive working environment, including culture of rewards, recognition, and respect.

**Why Join Core-Mark?**
Our mission is to be the most valued marketer of food, fresh and broadline supply solutions to the convenience retail industry.
Core-Mark emphasizes personal growth and development for all associates. We believe that when you succeed, the company succeeds. We promote internally whenever possible and provide frequent training opportunities in several formats to help you meet your personal and career goals.

**Position Details:**

* **Location:** 2311 East 48th Street, Los Angeles, CA, 90058
* **Work Schedule:** This is an onsite role, Monday-Friday, normal business hours
+ Subject to change based on business needs
* **Travel:** N/A
* **Compensation:** $85k-$95k base salary, depending on experience
+ Company Phone & Laptop/Equipment provided

**Position Summary:**
Reporting directly to the OpCo President, you will ensure your OpCo has the right products at the right time to meet customer needs by collaborating closely with a centralized purchasing team to execute purchasing strategies. In addition to this coordination, you will take direct ownership of managing local suppliers for fresh dairy, food items, produce and inventory. By optimizing inventory levels, analyzing demand forecasts, placing frequent purchase orders and working with cross-functional teams, you will drive improvements in fill rates and earned income and reduce aged inventory, playing a key role in the success of our organization.

**Responsibilities:**
Communication:

* Ensure OpCo specific needs (new customers, operational constraints, seasonality, etc.) are addressed.
* Communicate purchasing specific initiatives that would impact operational personnel.
* Establish solid relationships with corporate purchasing team.
* Meet with OpCo president monthly to review and discuss the “traffic report” from previous period.
* Address inventory concerns including aging, overstock, and spoils risk.
* Prepare and communicate customer specific scorecards as needed.
* Track spoils and spoils risk, partner with corporate buyers to reduce spoils risk.
* Monitor late PO reports and provide action steps to corporate purchasing team or OpCo receiving department.

Purchasing:

* Review and maintain forecasting and inventory levels to ensure achievement of targeted fill rate for assigned suppliers.
* Manage all aspects of the inner house and DCIS process between Core-Mark OpCos.
* Act as the buyer of record for all purchasing activity between assigned Core-Mark OpCo and PFG OpCos.
* Monitor and communicate all purchasing aspects of our PFG Food Service programs to OpCo and corporate associates.
* Review and execute Sku Rationalization process every quarter.
* Create RPO returns for regulated suppliers in SAP OpCos.

Income:

* Negotiate with suppliers to develop and execute OpCo specific income opportunities.
* Maintaining promotions and allowance with assigned vendors.
* Track and manage speed to market programs for regulated suppliers.
* Engage and facilitate marketing initiatives with customers such as flyers and ads.
* Assist with OpCo or regional Expo/Trade Shows as needed.
* Manage audit process to ensure all deductions are legitimate.

Miscellaneous:

* Travel when required for position (less than 10%).
* Understand and review OpCo P&L.
* Maintain safe work environment, adhere to safety procedures.

**The ideal candidate should possess the following:**

* Expert-level proficiency in Excel (must include advanced Pivot Tables) and PowerBI.
* Direct, hands-on experience utilizing AS400 and R6 systems (knowledge of SAP remains highly desired).
* Direct, hands-on experience placing purchase orders with vendors on a weekly basis.
* Experience negotiating merchandising income opportunities as a plus.
* Experience managing short shelf-life products (food, produce, dairy, etc.).
* Ability to analyze multiple forms of data as it relates to the decision-making process.
* Demonstrated professional leadership and negotiation abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and solve problems.
* Able to work independently and communicate effectively (written and verbal).
* Proficiency in Excel, other Microsoft Office products, and Windows-based programs.
* Familiarity or working knowledge of DCMS, R6, AS400 and SAP highly desired.
* Ability to interact effectively with a wide variety of vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Knowledge of or ability to learn principles and practices of Purchasing, Sales, and Marketing.

Under general direction, supervises, plans, and coordinates the activities and operations of the City’s centralized purchasing operations. Coordinates assigned activities with other departments, outside agencies, and the general public, supervises staff, and provides highly responsible and complex assistance to the Chief Financial Officer.

**Position Snapshot/A Day in the Life:** The Purchasing Manager leads Fontana’s centralized procurement operations, helping departments obtain goods and services efficiently while ensuring compliance with City policies and public-contracting requirements. The role oversees purchasing staff, solicitations, contracts, purchase orders, vendor relations, staff training, and process improvements. The ideal candidate combines strong public procurement expertise with responsive customer service, sound judgment, effective collaboration, and a commitment to protecting public funds.

* Establishes and maintains cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.

* Maintains prompt and regular attendance.

* Operational characteristics, services and activities of a comprehensive municipal purchasing program.

**Job Title:** Supply Chain Procurement Manager

**Job Location:** Redmond, WA

**Job Schedule:** 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Supply Chain Leader to build, optimize, and scale a high-performing supply chain organization across a growing multi-site aerospace manufacturing enterprise. This role will lead end-to-end supply chain operations including sourcing, procurement, planning and supplier development.

The ideal candidate brings deep aerospace or highly regulated manufacturing experience and has successfully stood up or transformed a modern, efficient supply chain organization in a complex operational environment. This leader will drive operational excellence, supplier performance, cost competitiveness, and scalable processes that support rapid growth, delivery performance, and customer satisfaction.

This position requires a hands-on leader who can balance strategic vision with tactical execution across multiple facilities and product lines.

The successful candidate will be a strategic yet hands-on leader with a strong operational mindset, capable of driving change in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This individual should bring a track record of building efficient organizations, improving execution, and developing high-performing teams.

This is an opportunity to play a critical leadership role in shaping the future operations and scalability of a growing aerospace organization.

**Essential Functions:**

* Strategic Leadership
+ Develop and execute an enterprise-wide supply chain strategy aligned with company growth objectives, customer commitments, and operational priorities.
+ Build and lead a multi-site supply chain organization that is standardized, scalable, and performance-oriented.
+ Assess current-state processes, organizational structure, systems, and capabilities; design and implement a future-state operating model that improves efficiency, visibility, and accountability.
+ Lead procurement, strategic sourcing, planning, and supplier development across multiple sites
+ Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, partnering closely with Operations, Program Management, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and Business Development.
* Organizational Design and Transformation
+ Lead the stand-up, redesign, or transformation of the supply chain organization, including roles, responsibilities, governance, and process ownership.
+ Establish clear functional alignment across sourcing, procurement, planning, master scheduling, inventory control, logistics, and supplier management.
+ Drive standard work, common metrics, and integrated planning processes across all sites.
+ Build organizational capability through talent assessment, coaching, succession planning, and targeted hiring.
* Procurement and Supplier Management
+ Lead strategic sourcing and procurement activities to ensure cost competitiveness, supply continuity, and strong supplier performance.
+ Develop supplier segmentation, risk management, and performance management processes to improve quality, delivery, responsiveness, and resilience.
+ Negotiate key supplier agreements and partnerships, including long-term agreements where appropriate.
+ Partner with Quality and Engineering to strengthen supplier qualification, development, and corrective action processes.
* Planning, Inventory, and Operations Support
+ Improve material availability and on-time delivery while optimizing inventory, working capital, and lead times.
+ Drive cross-functional execution to resolve shortages, constraints, and capacity issues.
* Systems, Process, and Performance Improvement
+ Champion the use of ERP/MRP systems, analytics, and reporting tools to improve planning accuracy, material visibility, and decision-making.
+ Implement KPIs and management operating rhythms focused on on-time delivery, supplier quality, lead time, inventory turns, material availability, and cost performance.
+ Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar operational excellence methodologies.
+ Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace, regulatory, contractual, and customer requirements.

**Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience in aerospace, defense, or highly regulated manufacturing
* Experience leading end-to-end supply chain functions, including sourcing, procurement, planning, inventory management, logistics, and supplier performance.
* Strong track record of driving measurable improvements in on-time delivery, inventory performance, cost, supplier reliability, and process efficiency.

**RCI Custom**

**Start Your Career in Supply Chain & Purchasing**

RCI Custom is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Entry-Level Procurement Specialist** to join our growing team. Pay: $18.00 - $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

**Job Summary**

The Stocking Specialist / Buyer supports nursery operations by monitoring stock levels, sourcing plant material, and ordering replenishments for assigned departments. This role works closely with vendors, receiving staff, and internal teams to ensure plant material and related inventory are available to meet operational and sales needs while avoiding shortages, overstocks, or inactive inventory.

The Stocking Specialist / Buyer manages purchase orders, coordinates deliveries, resolves vendor issues, and maintains accurate vendor and inventory records. This role balances daily operational needs with efficient purchasing practices to support consistent product availability across the nursery.

**Essential Functions**

* Research and source plant material for special orders requested by the Sales Team.
* Maintain positive and effective relationships with plant vendors and suppliers.
* Maintain and update vendor information in company systems.
* Create and process purchase orders for plant material and related items.
* Verify receipt of purchased materials and work with vendors to resolve shipment discrepancies, shortages, or damages.
* Negotiate with vendors to obtain competitive pricing while maintaining quality standards.
* Ensure purchase documentation and approvals are completed so vendor payments can be processed in a timely manner.
* Serve as a liaison between internal departments and vendors to coordinate purchasing and delivery needs.
* Work with vendors to schedule or expedite deliveries and resolve delivery issues such as shortages, late deliveries, or missed shipments.
* Coordinate logistics to ensure plant material arrives at the appropriate nursery location in a timely manner.
* Monitor changes in plant availability, vendor pricing, and purchasing terms.
* Participate in pricing updates, inventory projects, and other operational initiatives as needed.
* Support administrative tasks related to purchasing, inventory, and vendor coordination.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Assist with inventory-related projects and operational initiatives as needed.
* Support cross-departmental coordination related to purchasing and stocking activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience & Other Requirements**

**Required**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience working in a nursery, horticulture, or related industry.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate multiple purchasing and inventory activities simultaneously.

**Preferred**

* Associate degree (AA) or higher.
* Experience creating purchase orders within inventory or ERP systems.
* Familiarity with plant sourcing and vendor coordination within nursery operations.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This is an in-office position located at the nursery site. Remote work is not available except for short-term situations approved in advance by upper management.

The role requires regular movement between office and nursery yard environments.

Physical requirements include:

* Remaining in a stationary position (sitting or standing) for extended periods.
* Frequent typing and use of computer systems including data entry and 10-key functions.
* Use of hands and fingers for typing, filing, and operating office equipment.
* Gross grasping and manual handling of documents or office materials.
* Occasional walking through outdoor nursery areas which may involve uneven ground surfaces and exposure to varying weather conditions.
* Lifting up to 20 lbs. approximately 20% of the time.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Reporting to the Director of Procurement, you will support Protein Procurement by leading research, implementing category strategies, resolving complex supply challenges, and building relationships with internal teams and external suppliers. You will perform detailed category analysis, forecasting, and reporting while collaborating across functions to identify process improvements and strategic opportunities.

**A Taste of Your Responsibilities**
------------------------------------

* Manage purchasing and negotiations for assigned protein categories based on market conditions and business requirements.
* Develop category strategies informed by supply and demand, market dynamics, and cost drivers.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
* Support contract and position management using Excel, Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing software, RightAngle, Profitability and Performance Management, and other internal systems.
* Serve as the primary contact for contract management support across assigned areas.
* Identify and mitigate material supply risks in partnership with procurement category managers and cross-functional teams.
* Support Research and Development initiatives and manage inbound supply considerations for innovation projects.
* Implement enterprise procurement initiatives across assigned brands.
* Gather data and conduct risk-and-reward analyses for purchasing bids and specification change initiatives.
* Collaborate across functions to manage raw material inventories and minimize loss or obsolescence.
* Deliver accurate monthly forecasts and communicate changes in material costs and market drivers to stakeholders.
* Monitor supplier quality and service performance with internal customers.
* Champion corrective actions and quality improvement plans with facilities, Quality Assurance, Research and Development, and suppliers.

**Ingredients Required for Your Success**
-----------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience in Purchasing, Supply Chain, or Finance.
* Experience working in a matrixed environment with changing priorities.
* Project management and conflict management experience.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on efficiency.
* Experience using Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing software or a comparable enterprise resource planning system.
* Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and data relationships.
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation development skills.

**Company Overview**

Specified Technologies Inc. (STI) is an industry leader in the development of firestopping systems, smoke and sound control products, and innovative construction solutions. For over 36 years, STI has partnered with contractors, engineers, and building owners to provide tested, trusted, and code‑compliant solutions worldwide.

Headquartered in Somerville, New Jersey, the company has grown to serve multiple markets and geographies and remains committed to innovation, safety, and performance in passive fire protection.

**Role Description**

We’re seeking an experienced **Procurement Specialist**. The ideal candidate will maximize ERP/MRP utilization (specifically within Acumatica or SAP), build strong vendor relationships, mitigate supply chain risks, streamline inventory and operational workflows, and establish a best-in-class supplier relationship management program.

This is a **hybrid** role based out of our Corporate Headquarters in **Somerville, New Jersey** with an expectation of **three days per week in the office.**

**Key areas of experience**

* Cross-Functional Collaboration (Manufacturing, NPI & Planning)
* Strategic Sourcing & Category Management
* Systems & Operational Integration
* Contract Negotiation & Supplier Management
* Supplier Performance Control
* Financial & Budgetary Oversight
* Leadership & Team Development
* Ability to meet or exceed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs & Metrics)
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required or assigned.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).

**Experience**

* 5-10+ years of progressive procurement/sourcing experience in manufacturing environments, specializing in Chemical procurement.

**Skills**

* Proven track record supporting NPI processes, bill of materials (BOM) sourcing, and material planning integration.
* Hands-on experience with modern ERP systems (direct experience with Acumatica MRP/WMS is highly desirable).
* Strong contract negotiation, supplier performance management, financial acumen, and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Certifications (Preferred): CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management), CSCP (APICS/ASCM), or Lean Six Sigma certification

**Why You’ll Love Working Here (Benefits & Perks)**

At Specified Technologies Inc. (STI), you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, integrity, and individual growth. We’re committed to supporting your well-being, work-life balance, and financial future through a comprehensive benefits package, including:

**Healthcare Coverage** – Medical insurance options, plus dental and vision plans to keep you and your family healthy

**401(k) Retirement Plan** – Build your financial future with employer contributions

**Company-Paid Life Insurance** – Added peace of mind for you and your loved ones

**Generous Paid Time Off** – Company-paid holidays, vacation, floating, and sick time to support work-life balance

**Collaborative Team Environment** – Work with people who support you, value your contributions, and want to see you succeed

**Compensation** - **$90,000 - $115,000**

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Please note: This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or H-1B transfer. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and not require sponsorship now or in the future.

Primary Purpose

The Procurement Specialist supports the Agency’s procurement and inventory operations by maintaining accurate vendor

and inventory records, processing inventory submissions, assisting Staff with quotes and purchasing needs, monitoring

stock and pricing fluctuations, and ensuring timely, organized, and compliant procurement activities.

Education and Qualification Requirements

* Minimum: High School Diploma or Equivalency
* Valid Florida Driver's License
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Basic knowledge of general office equipment

Duties

* Provide customer service to walk‑in Staff members and respond to procurement‑related inquiries.
* Maintain vendor records, insurance certificates, catalogs, and supplier performance data.
* Source and evaluate vendors, obtain quotes, and support purchasing decisions.
* Enter and process requisitions, procurement forms, and inventory submissions.
* Monitor stock levels, pricing, and reorder points; research pricing and bulk purchase options.
* Review purchase orders, confirm vendor receipt, and support PO processing as needed.
* Manage issued property records and coordinate returns or transfers for Staff members.
* Update inventory‑related spreadsheets and run reports as requested.
* Maintain accurate files in agency systems and support annual inventory activities.
* Handle multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and apply procurement best practices while adhering to Agency

policies and confidentiality requirements.

* Other duties as assigned.

Job Controls and Complexities

* Report directly to Supervisor.
* Adhere to laws/agency policy/rules/ regulations/SOP/ procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality/security of files and information obtained in the course of employment.
* Process/compile/disseminate record/public record information as directed by approving authority in accordance

with lawful requirements.

* Maintain continuity and operational efficiency by accurate and timely dissemination of information to Staff and

co-workers.

* Adhere to leave, overtime and attendance policies/procedures (i.e. arrive promptly, regular attendance at work,

notification to supervisor regarding absence from work due to illness or untimely incidents, etc.)

* Demonstrates strong teamwork, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Takes initiative, troubleshoot issues, and maintain momentum on assignments.
* Works independently with sound judgment while following verbal and written instructions.
* Prepares clear, accurate, and timely documentation.
* Applies logical, collaborative problem‑solving techniques to ensure efficient use of resources.
* Maintains professionalism, tact, and diplomacy in difficult situations when working with colleagues, other

agencies, vendors, and the public.

Contacts

* SJSO Employees
* Other government employees
* General Public
* Vendors and Suppliers

Grade Classification

* Entry to intermediate level work.
* Performs independently under general supervision.
* Work requires application of general knowledge of business practices in various situations.
* Deals with problems or situations that remain stable.

Physical Environment

* Work is primarily in an office environment under normal amount of stress.
* Normal business hours apply; however, hours are subject to vary and overtime may be necessary including nights,

weekends, and holidays.

description:
The Specialist, Procurement is responsible for executing procurement activities in support of defense and aerospace programs, including the acquisition of raw materials, components, assemblies, equipment, and services necessary to meet program, production, and customer requirements. This role applies professional procurement knowledge to support supplier selection, pricing analysis, purchase order administration, and supplier performance management while ensuring alignment with quality, cost, delivery, and compliance objectives. The position works under general supervision and contributes to operational and program success through effective sourcing, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team supporting complex programs in a highly regulated environment.

**Essential Functions:**

* Plans and executes procurement activities for raw materials, components, equipment, and services in support of defense and aerospace program requirements.
* Solicits, reviews, and analyzes supplier quotations, proposals, and bids to support sourcing decisions and cost objectives.
* Negotiates pricing, terms and conditions, and delivery commitments in accordance with company policies and program requirements.
* Issues and administers purchase orders through completion, including management of acknowledgements, deliveries, invoice discrepancies, and order closeout.
* Evaluates supplier capability, performance, and risk related to quality, cost, schedule, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinates with internal stakeholders including engineering, manufacturing, quality, program management, and finance to ensure procurement actions support technical and contractual requirements.
* Resolves supplier-related issues involving shortages, damages, returns, over-shipments, cancellations, and engineering or configuration changes.
* Maintains accurate procurement records and supports audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and reporting requirements.
* Reviews market conditions, supplier trends, and pricing data to recommend sourcing strategies and process improvements.
* Ensures procurement activities are conducted in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual requirements, anti-corruption standards, and ethical business practices.
* May provide guidance, coaching, or day-to-day support to less experienced employees within the job area
* Travel up to 20% may be required.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant procurement experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related procurement experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related procurement experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience supporting defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) requirements.
* Experience procuring electronic components, mechanical parts, complex assemblies, or specialized services.
* Familiarity with supplier performance management, cost analysis, and schedule risk mitigation.
* Experience supporting engineering change activity, configuration changes, and material returns.
* Working knowledge of export compliance considerations, including International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
* Experience using material requirements planning or enterprise resource planning tools in a production or program environment.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Washington, and the Greater D.C. area, Denver, or NYC areas is $79,000.00 - $147,000.00. The salary range for this role in Colorado state, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Minnesota, New York state, Cleveland Ohio, Vermont and Virginia is $69,500.00 - $128,500.00 This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.
