description:
***International Shoppes*** has been delivering exceptional service and premium retail experiences to travelers since 1951. We proudly operate across some of the nation's busiest airports, including John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD), Baltimore / Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI), Bradley International Airport (BDL), George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH), Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL), and Kahului Airport (OGG). We are committed to providing an outstanding shopping experience while representing many of the world's most recognized luxury, beauty, and lifestyle brands.

**Position Overview:**

The **Associate Buyer of Beauty** is responsible for providing market expertise, filtering the assortment, and establishing quantities that meet the Region's needs and financial goals within open to buy parameters. Demonstrates smart risk-taking in business and product decisions and clearly communicates and manages team to execute these decisions. Supports the Buyers by providing analysis and results for their category, recommends action against the results and follows through on executing this action. Coordinate daily activities across designated departments to facilitate responsibilities.

**Responsibilities:**

* PO Management and Execution
+ Review Brand Sell In and Write Monthly Orders with OTB
+ Review and introduce novelties for various in store activations
* Stock Maintenance- review WOS and opportunity for clean up
+ Duty Paid Allocation management and execution
- Splits/Duty Paid Transfers
- Work with store teams to determine needs of business
* Negotiate vendor returns and destructions
* Review and Implement Vendor Funded Promotions
* Quarterly Store Walkthrough /Attend Vendor Walkthroughs
* Various Ad – Hoc Reporting
* Identify product opportunities and trends which will impact the business and provide results
* Liaise with visual team to ensure that all products are properly on sales floor for optimization
* Manage product selection and assortment during market
* Analyze sales trends, key items, vendor profitability and aged inventory as well as making recommendations for driving improved performance
* Writing orders, changes, cancellations and necessary follow-up (both internally and externally) to ensure key shipments are delivered and processed.
* Monitoring of merchandise reports, Open-to-Buy monitoring, stock analysis and other ad hoc analyses.
* Manage product set up and maintenance.
* Ensure all markdowns and store promotions are entered and set up properly in system
* Establish and maintain relationships with outside vendors to stay abreast and informed of supply issues, new products, lead times and reliability
* Pull relevant sales, margin and price point reporting and make recommendations based on results to improve business portfolio.
* Performs other duties as determined by management but not limited to the above-mentioned responsibilities.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience.
* 4+ years of experience in Buying Role.
* Grasp and navigate a wide range of business relationships; negotiation skills.
* Creative product skills and comprehensive market knowledge.
* Ability to think conceptually and strategically regarding business; creative problem solver.
* Strong analytical and communication skills.
* Demonstrates initiative, is conscientious and provides complete follow-through on all aspects of responsibility
* Ability to multitask and focus in a busy atmosphere
* Comfortable with team-based work structure, ability to demonstrate flexibility
* Excellent time management and communication skills
* High level of proficiency in Word and Excel.

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Full - Time 40 hours/week
* Benefits: Medical, Dental, 401K
* Merchandise Discounts
* Vacation / Personal / Sick time
* Traveling opportunities
* Great work environment

**To ensure that we continue to hire competent, ethical and trustworthy individuals, all candidates will be required to complete a thorough Port Authority Security background check prior to receiving any final offer of employment from International Shoppes.**

***\\*We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer\\****

**Position: Per Diem Purchasing Associate**

**Location: Barlow Respiratory Hospital, 2000 Stadium Way, Los Angeles**

**Job Summary:**

The Per Diem Purchasing Associate plays a crucial role in the operations of Barlow Respiratory Hospital's Materials Management Department. This position is responsible for the efficient receipt, storage, and distribution of all materials delivered by various vendors to the hospital. The ideal candidate will ensure that all materials are handled efficiently and stored properly, contributing to the smooth operation of hospital services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Receipt of Deliveries:** Accurately receive materials delivered to the Materials Management Department, ensuring all items are accounted for against delivery documents.
* **Storage:** Properly store all received materials in designated areas, maintaining an organized and efficient inventory system.
* **Distribution:** Timely distribute materials to various departments within the hospital, ensuring that all internal requests for materials are fulfilled accurately and promptly.
* **Inventory Management:** Assist in maintaining accurate inventory records, participating in inventory counts and reconciliations as required.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Interact with vendors during the delivery process to resolve any discrepancies or issues that may arise.
* **Compliance:** Adhere to hospital policies and procedures related to materials handling, storage, and distribution.

**Requirements:**

* Computer literacy, with proficiency in inventory management software and Microsoft Office applications.
* Valid driver’s license, with a clean driving record.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to lift and move heavy items as needed.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Flexibility to work on a per diem basis, with varying hours according to departmental needs.
* **Per Diem position**

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Previous experience in materials management, inventory control, or a related field is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with purchasing software (e.g. MediTech) Preferred
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel

Barlow Respiratory Hospital is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals who are passionate about contributing to our team and supporting the health and well-being of our community.

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: From $21.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8.0 – 16.0 per week

Experience:

* Purchasing department : 1 year (Required)

**As an Associate Buyer:**

* You are responsible for relationship building and management for specific vendor lines. You procure products at aggressive pricing by artfully negotiating through multiple sources.
* You participate in new contract terms and pricing for new products and vendors. Additionally, you act as an agent for the company for SKU creation and maintenance, internal problem resolution, and investigating and resolving product packaging and receiving issues.

**Primary Job Duties:**

* Track and manage virtual and/or drop ship inventory to support sales and web activity.
* Maintain SKU status to support sales and web activity.
* Negotiate the lowest cost possible.
* Expedite purchase orders and update ETA’s.
* Work on price protection claims and follow through with necessary sell price changes.
* Review vendor & distributor promotions.
* Analyze and take action as necessary on backorder reports.
* Evaluate non-productive SKUs.
* Resolve product-packaging issues.
* Resolve receiving issues.
* Obtain return authorizations for stock rotations and customer returns.
* Communicate with Sales, Tech Support, Returns, Credit, A/P, Finance, I/S, Customer Service, Receiving, Ad Production, Supply Chain, and Management.
* Respond to internal communication through Connection's Call Tracker/Case Management system.
* Work with Product Marketing Managers in product consideration.
* Order product for evaluation where applicable.

**Required Job Competencies:**

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite with the ability to create a document or simple spreadsheet.
* Possess a working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite with the ability to create a document or simple spreadsheet.
* Articulate with the ability to express oneself clearly and professionally in written and oral communication.
* Technical aptitude with the ability to absorb and apply newly learned technical skills.
* Detail-oriented and organized, with excellent time management, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

**Company Overview**

Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 800+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity.

We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them.

**The Role**

As our first Head of Procurement, you will build our global procurement function from scratch, directly driving profitability through strategic vendor alignment. Your leadership will secure critical telecom partnerships and transform procurement into a sustainable growth engine.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build Holafly's global procurement strategy from the ground up to support rapid international expansion.
* Negotiate high-stakes telecom contracts to secure top-tier pricing, quality, and SLA terms across markets.
* Establish company-wide procurement policies and vendor risk frameworks for governance.
* Optimize global supplier spend, unlocking cost savings without compromising service quality.
* Scale vendor performance metrics to ensure long-term supplier reliability across 200+ destinations.
* Partner with cross-functional leadership to align procurement goals with overarching product strategy.

**Qualifications**

* Proven procurement leadership, +5 years exp. ideally within a fast-growing scale-up or tech environment.
* Direct experience building procurement frameworks and vendor management workflows from zero.
* Expertise in international contract negotiations and financial analysis for complex service agreements.
* Strong leadership capabilities with a passion for designing scalable processes.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in Telecom, Connectivity, or SaaS environments.
* Knowledge of international vendor compliance and cross-border operations.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Fully Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with trust-based flexibility and a focus on work-life balance.
* Professional Development Stipend: Dedicated budgets for continuous education, courses, and certifications.
* Global Scale-Up Impact: Direct influence on the future of connectivity within an international culture.
* Competitive Package: Enjoy comprehensive benefits, continuous learning, and real opportunities for career growth.

Western Washington University, with over 15,000 students in seven colleges and the graduate school, is nationally recognized for its educational programs, students and faculty. Western's greatest strength is the outstanding students, faculty, staff, and alumni/ae who make up its community. Western supports an inclusive governance structure for all and provides a learning and working environment in which everyone can thrive. Further, individual employees are expected to have the ability to operationalize sustainability concepts (economic, societal, environmental) into all aspects of performing their job duties.

The Business Services Department supports Western’s mission, which states that together with our students, staff, and faculty, we are committed to making a positive impact in the state and the world with a shared focus on academic excellence and inclusive achievement. All are encouraged to apply, including women, people of color, people with disabilities, veterans, and other candidates from underrepresented backgrounds and with diverse experiences interested in this opportunity.

Business Services helps the Western community navigate the policies, systems, and requirements that support purchasing, contracting, travel, and other essential university activities. The department is committed to providing practical guidance, responsible stewardship of university resources, and accessible, reliable service to campus partners.

**Summary:**

* The Chief Procurement Officer has oversight for the procurement program for all County offices, including developing and implementing procurement policies and procedures and oversees the professional and clerical staff.

**Essential Duties:**

* Manage the County's centralized purchasing function including the procurement activities of the professional and clerical staff.
* Establish departmental objectives, directs priorities, interprets purchasing policies, rules, and regulations governing procurement activities.
* Maintain relationships with contractors and suppliers to resolve problems, explore new business opportunities and maintain productive partnerships.
* Assist and educate County personnel of all levels in resolving purchasing discrepancies and familiarizing managers with purchasing laws in areas from processing requisitions to conforming to terms and conditions of contracts.
* Develop specifications and documents for solicitation of public Invitations to Bid and Requests for Proposals on major procurements of equipment, materials and services for all County agencies.
* Oversee conduct of the bidding process, insuring compliance with legal, regulatory and other requirements governing public procurement.
* Interview and work with contractors, suppliers, department heads and other officials concerning the purchasing of supplies and equipment.
* Function as chairperson of RFP evaluation committees (when applicable); provides technical expertise concerning contract specifications; analyzes bid and proposal responses, and administers the entire formal public bidding process.
* Participate in professional or collegial organizations that provide information and/or purchasing opportunities for the County, e.g. Lehigh Valley Cooperative Purchasing Council (LVCPC), the Southeastern Pennsylvania Counties Cooperative Purchasing Board (SPCCPB), the Pennsylvania Public Purchasing Association (PAPPA), NIGP: The Institute for Public Procurement.
* Perform related work as needed.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* The Chief Procurement Officer has supervisory responsibility for approximately (6) direct reports.

**Qualifications:**

* To perform this job successfully, the individual in this position must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the minimum knowledge, skills and ability required.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of five (5) years' experience procuring goods and services, and managing competitive bids/proposals with the responsibility of at least $10 million in purchases annually and at least 30 user departments. Public procurement experience preferred, including familiarity with all aspects of Invitations to Bid and Requests for Proposal.
* Thorough knowledge of goals, objectives, methods and techniques applicable to the management of a centralized procurement program.
* Extensive knowledge and understanding of County policies and procedures, general law of contracts and Commonwealth, Federal, cooperative and other types of contracts.
* Thorough knowledge of methods, techniques and legal requirements commonly employed in purchasing commodities and services used by government at the local level.
* Thorough knowledge in using personal computers including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook) and internet applications.

Description

The Kentucky Department of Corrections (DOC), Division of Adult Institutions operates 13 correctional facilities that house Kentucky's adult inmate population. The mission of DOC is to protect the citizens of the Commonwealth and to provide a safe, secure and humane environment for staff and offenders in carrying out the mandates of the legislative and judicial processes; and, to provide opportunities for offenders to acquire skills which facilitate non-criminal behavior.

This position is for the new Medical Facility, located on the grounds of Blackburn Correctional Complex.

If you are looking for a career within the Department of Corrections that provides opportunity for career development, then the Department of Corrections may have an opportunity for you! We are hiring a Purchasing Officer I. This position performs beginning level duties in the procurement of and, or, payment of goods and non-professional services on an agency wide-basis.

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Gathers, prepares and maintains purchase and payment documents.
* Works with vendors to collect quotes, invoices and etc.
* Pro Card Holder and reconciles purchases.
* Monitors purchases made for conformance with the Model Procurement Code, (KRS 45A)
* Performs beginning level duties in the performance of and, or, payment of goods and non-professional services in accordance with the agency’s Small Purchase Authority.
* Performs other duties as directed by Fiscal Manager and Supervisor.

Minimum Requirements

**EDUCATION:** Graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree.

**EXPERIENCE, TRAINING, OR SKILLS:** NONE

**Substitute EDUCATION for EXPERIENCE:** NONE

**Substitute EXPERIENCE for EDUCATION:** Experience in purchasing will substitute for the required college on a year for year basis. Certification with the National Institute of Governmental Purchasing as a Certified Professional Public Buyer (CPPB) will substitute for one year of the college requirement OR certification as a Certified Public Purchasing Officer (CPPO) will substitute for two years of the college requirement.

**SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS (AGE, LICENSURE, REGULATION, ETC.):** NONE

Working Conditions

Incumbents working in this job title perform duties in an office setting.

Probationary Period

This job has an initial and promotional probationary period of 6 months, except as provided in KRS 18A.111.

If you have questions about this advertisement, please contact Kasey Schank at Kasey.Schank@ky.gov

An Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D

**SUMMARY**

The Procurement and Asset Management Officer provides organization-wide leadership for procurement, purchasing systems, vendor and contract management, inventory control, and fixed-asset administration. The position establishes and maintains procurement policies, approval workflows, vendor standards, reporting requirements, and system controls designed to promote cost efficiency, accountability, compliance, and operational reliability.

The position has primary responsibility for administering and continuously improving the organization’s procurement and purchase-order systems and works closely with executive leadership, Finance, Accounts Payable, Information Technology, Facilities, and department heads.

The Officer exercises organization-wide functional authority over procurement and asset-management processes within delegated limits established by the Executive Director and the organization’s Procurement Policy. The position supports compliance with the Board-approved budget but does not independently approve organizational budgets, transfer funds, authorize unbudgeted expenditures, or execute contracts unless specifically delegated by the Executive Director. Department heads remain responsible for departmental operations and budgets, subject to executive oversight. This authority is exercised under the direction and oversight of the COO and does not supersede the authority of the Executive Director, CFO, executive team, or Board of Directors

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Procurement and Strategic Sourcing

* Lead and administer centralized procurement across all departments.
* Develop, recommend, and enforce purchasing policies within delegated authority.
* Review purchasing requests for compliance with policy, budget, specifications, and documentation requirements.
* Manage sourcing, bidding, vendor selection, contract negotiations, renewals, and supplier performance within delegated authority.
* Identify cost savings, cost avoidance, volume discounts, standardization opportunities, and purchasing efficiencies.
* Monitor spending by department, category, vendor, contract, and budget.
* Address noncompliant, emergency, duplicate, unauthorized, and off-contract purchases.

Procurement Systems and Process Improvement

* Administer and continuously improve the organization’s procurement and purchase-order systems, including workflow design, user access, system configuration, data integrity, reporting, documentation, training, procure-to-pay procedures, and coordination with Finance, Accounts Payable, Information Technology, and department users.

* Establish performance measures and continuously improve procurement processes and service delivery.
* Establish inventory standards, item classifications, reorder points, safety-stock levels, cycle counts, and stockroom procedures.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and investigate variances, shortages, excess stock, obsolete materials, and receiving discrepancies.
* Implement barcode or QR-code tracking where appropriate.
* Optimize purchasing schedules, order consolidation, product standardization, and inventory levels.

Fixed-Asset Management

* Maintain accurate records of assets from acquisition through assignment, transfer, maintenance, retirement, and disposal.
* Track equipment, technology, facilities assets, furnishings, and other organizational properties,
* Maintain information regarding asset location, custodian, condition, serial number, warranty, service history, and replacement needs.
* Coordinate asset inventories, reconciliations, transfers, secure disposal, and retirement with Finance, Information Technology, Facilities, and other departments.
* Support lifecycle planning, warranty management, preventive maintenance, and capital-replacement forecasting.

Executive Reporting and Planning

* Provide reports to the COO, CFO, and executive leadership regarding expenditures, savings, PO compliance, vendor performance, contract renewals, inventory accuracy, asset condition, and capital needs.
* Support annual budgeting and multi-year capital planning through analysis of asset age, condition, repair history, useful life, and total cost of ownership.
* Escalate procurement, vendor, compliance, inventory, or asset risks and recommend corrective action.
* **Other Duties:** Perform other related duties as assigned by the COO or Management

There are no supervisory responsibilities required in this position.

Procurement Officer - (26142519)

**Why should you keep reading and consider working here?**

We know you have other work options, but we ask you to consider working with us at the State of Montana Department of Administration (DOA). Our foundation of success is having effective working relationships, built on mutual trust and respect. We will challenge you to be the best you can be and will work hard to provide a work environment that allows you to succeed. (You can learn more about the DOA here.)

**A Little About Our Business**

The State Procurement Services Division (SPSD) leads best-in-class procurement services through integrity, education, transparency, and innovation. We strive to administer effective and responsible procurements to maximize the value of public funds for Montana.

**What is this career opportunity?**
The Department of Administration's State Procurement Services Division is looking for a Procurement Officer who solves problems and communicates exceptionally well to support the Department of Corrections (DOC).

The State of Montana recently implemented a centralized procurement model built around an enterprise procurement team plus agency-based staff who work alongside the agencies they serve. In this role, you'll be a Department of Administration employee located at DOC, providing procurement support directly to the department. You'll be one of four procurement officers reporting to the DOC procurement supervisor.

You would be responsible for overseeing and coordinating all procurement activities within the DOC ensuring procurements and contracts are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable laws, policies, procedures, and funding requirements. This position mentor’s DOC staff in procurement procedures, conducts solicitations for goods and services, and provides contract oversight and management of all assigned and on-going contracts.

If you have good judgment, organizational skills, and the ability to explain complex procurement and contracting requirements to a wide range of internal stakeholders you should apply! We are interested in an individual that is experienced in procurement but also open to someone that is passionate about learning and growing in this role.

Responsibilities Include:

* Develop clear scopes of work, specifications, solicitation documents, evaluation criteria, and contract documentation.
* Conduct market research and analyze pricing, proposals, contract terms, and procurement risk.
* Manage competitive solicitations, evaluations, awards, and contract administration in a fair, transparent, and defensible manner.
* Coordinate contract amendments, renewals, corrective actions, and contract closeout activities.
* Maintain ethical conduct, confidentiality, impartiality, and complete audit-ready procurement files.
* Support procurements essential to Corrections operations, including healthcare, food service, safety and security, technology, and other DOC programs.

*In this position you will be afforded the opportunity to telework, however there will be required weekly in office day(s) in Helena. Specific conditions will be outlined as part of the job offer and must adhere to state policy.*

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Public Administration, Communication, or related field; OR
* Associate degree in Business Public Administration, Communication, or related field and two years’ experience in technical writing, research, or project management; OR
* Alternate combinations of education and experience will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

**Competencies:**

*Ability to:*

* Deliver outstanding customer service
* Conduct research, system analysis, and data gathering analysis
* Prioritize multiple projects and deadlines while working independently in a fast-paced public-sector environment.
* Learn the theory, principles, practices and techniques of government contracting
* Learn the State of Montana's procurement process, administrative rules, and federal procurement rules and laws
* Work and effectively communicate with diverse levels of management and stakeholders
* Establish objectives and priorities based on goals and general direction provided by management
* Identify problems, emerging issues and trends, and establish strategies to address them
* Mediate and resolve disputes
* Work independently with minimal supervision

**What can you expect from us in return for your work with our agency?**

**Title:** VIB Procurement Officer - #BVI00092

**State Role Title:** Procurement Officer I

**Hiring Range:** Starting salary low $60,000s up to high $60,000s commensurate with experience.

**Pay Band:** 4

**Agency:** Dept for Blind/Vision Impaired

**Location:** Blind & Vision Impaired

**Agency Website:** https://www.dbvi.virginia.gov

**Recruitment Type:** General Public - G

Help keep the mission moving by driving fast, accurate, and compliant purchasing across state and federal systems. If you’re energized by problem‑solving, vendor coordination, and owning a critical link in our production pipeline, we’d love to have you on the team.

**Job Duties:**

The objective/mission of the Virginia Industries for the Blind (VIB) is to employ and develop Virginians who are blind, visually impaired or deaf/blind to achieve their desired level of employment through the manufacture and delivery of quality products and services. To accomplish this objective / mission requires VIB to operate similar to a traditional business; maintaining efficient production, service and retail operations with strict financial controls to assure adhering to VIB's self-funded obligation, i.e., to accomplish its mission without the use of General Funds.

We are seeking a VIB Procurement Officer to process all assigned purchases in accordance with Commonwealth Purchasing Regulations and VIB Procurement Procedures for State-side; and process all assigned purchases in accordance with established federal procurement procedures. Obtains all required approvals for procurements that exceed delegated spend authority of $20,000. Provides procurement guidance to end-users. Assists VIB staff in maintaining and troubleshooting Procurement systems to include: eVA, Odoo, Counter Point (for a short period).

Duties include but are not limited to:

* General Procurement and Contracting
* Contract Management
* Communication, Troubleshooting, and Problem Solving
* Consult with Supervisor on any sensitive vendor or end user issues as they occur
* BSC Back-up Support:
+ Provide back-up support to the VIB Clerk for Counterpoint purchases on an as-need basis.
+ Processes Purchase Orders for EDI administrative items which are not stocked in BSCs.
+ Maintains procurement files to include all required documents.
- Purchase Requisition/specifications.
- Quotes
- Purchase Order and any other related documents.
+ Ensure accurate price quotes are obtained from vendors and/or verify the requested items are available via a contract from which VIB has approval to procure goods and/or services.
+ Receive and relay vendor messages to appropriate staff in an accurate and expedient manner.
+ Key data into Counterpoint within two business days of receiving Purchase Requisitions.
+ Request appropriate approvals prior to issuing Purchase Orders.

Other duties and/or special projects as assigned.

Completes duties and/or projects as needed or directed by supervisor.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Certification:

* Certification as a Virginia Contracting Associate.

Experience:

* Experience in the development of specifications packages, the management of Commonwealth of VA competitive solicitations and contract awards, processing sole source and emergency determinations.

Knowledge:

* Working knowledge of State procurement laws including but not limited to the Virginia Public Procurement Act (VPPA); and of the Agency Procurement Surplus Property Manual (APSPM).
* Proficiency with eVA procurement systems, e-commerce, and inventory management.

Skills:

* Demonstrated skill in using automated procurement systems, e commerce platforms, and inventory management tools.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; demonstrated telephone and customer service skills.
* Proficiency with automated purchasing software, MS Word, Excel, and database management.

Abilities:

* Demonstrated ability to process purchase requisitions into purchase orders in accordance with established policies and procedures supporting base supply operations.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret specifications and complete purchase orders in accordance with applicable policies and procedures.
* Ability to work effectively in a high-volume environment.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with vendors and internal end users.

**Additional Considerations:**

* Experience in Virginia public procurement/purchasing.
* Current Virginia Contract Administration and Risk Management (VCARM), Contracting Officer (VCO) certification or ability to obtain VCARM within one year of hire and VCO within two year(s) of hire; see https://vip.dgs.virginia.gov/ for more information on certification process.

description:
Make an impact on how Delaware does business. As a State Contract Procurement Officer I, you’ll help shape and manage contracts that support state agencies, schools, local governments, and other public organizations across Delaware. You’ll work with agency partners to develop solicitations, evaluate bids, recommend contract awards, manage existing contracts, and help ensure compliance with state procurement requirements. This is an opportunity to build valuable procurement and contract management expertise while contributing to efficient, responsible use of public resources. If you’re analytical, collaborative, detail-oriented, and ready to grow your career in public procurement, we invite you to apply.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

Essential functions are fundamental, core functions common to all positions in the class series and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties for any one position in the class. Since class specifications are descriptive and not restrictive, incumbents can complete job duties of similar kind not specifically listed here.

* Manages existing centralized contracts to ensure compliance with terms of contract; monitors vendor performance and resolves contract disputes, complaints and price discrepancies; negotiates changes.
* Provides consultation services; interprets and explains applicable laws, rules, regulations, policies and procedures for contract development, monitoring, accounting, and auditing.
* Develops, reviews, plans and coordinates procurement activities such as writing bid specifications, developing Request for Proposals (RFP) and Invitations to Bid (ITB), advertising for bid, and recommending contract awards.
* Researches, analyzes and interprets technical aspects of bid specifications for goods and professional and non-professional service contracts.
* Develops proposal criteria in coordination with user agencies.
* Develops contract baselines, terms and conditions through market analysis.
* Conducts pre-bid meetings, facilitates RFP selection committee and participates on related procurement contract committees.
* Negotiates new contracts and contract extensions with vendors using best and final offer techniques and Request for Proposal procedures; recommends contract award, prepares award notice and notifies successful vendors.
* Recommends changes to existing state procurement and contract management processes.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

**JOB REQUIREMENTS for State Contract Procurement Officer I**

Applicants must have education, training and/or experience demonstrating competence in each of the following areas:

* Six months experience in procurement services which includes purchasing goods and services in accordance with procurement procedures and contract specifications.

* Six months experience in contract management and control which includes ensuring compliance with terms of contracts; negotiating changes to existing contracts.

* Six months experience in interpreting laws, rules, regulations, standards, policies, and procedures.

* Knowledge of developing contracts for procurement of goods and services including researching and writing specifications, analyzing bids and recommending contract award.

**Conditions of Hire**
----------------------

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The State of Delaware Executive Branch participates in the Federal E-Verify system where the State will provide the federal government with each new hires Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. For more information refer to our job seeker resources.

All new hires are required to report to the **Statewide New Employee Orientation (SNEO)** on their first day of employment. Sessions are held at designated locations in Kent or New Castle County.

**Benefits**
------------

To learn more about the comprehensive benefit package please visit our website at https://dhr.delaware.gov/benefits/

**Selection Process**
---------------------

The application and supplemental questionnaire are evaluated based upon a rating of your education, training and experience as they relate to the job requirements of the position. It is essential that you provide complete and accurate information on your application and the supplemental questionnaire to include dates of employment, job title and job duties. For education and training, list name of educational provider, training course titles and summary of course content. Narrative information supplied in response to the questions must be supported by the information supplied on the application including your employment, education and training history as it relates to the job requirements.

Once you have submitted your application on-line, all future correspondence related to your application will be sent via email. Please keep your contact information current. You may also view all correspondence sent to you by the State of Delawar

**Procurement Coordinator**
===========================

Riddleberger Brothers, Inc. (RBI), a leading mechanical contractor in the Shenandoah Valley, is seeking a Procurement Coordinator to join our service team in Mount Crawford, VA. This full-time position will manage purchasing processes, vendor relationships, inventory, and material logistics to support efficient service operations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and manage purchasing processes that promote value and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate equipment and material purchasing to support project schedules and minimize work in progress.
* Prioritize and process call-in material orders.
* Issue purchase orders with accurate vendor, part, pricing, and job or truck-stock information.
* Follow up with vendors, technicians, customers, and dispatchers regarding material availability and delivery schedules.
* Negotiate with vendors to secure the best overall value.
* Utilize vendors participating in the Comfort Systems USA National Purchasing Program.
* Process material returns, warranty claims, and RMA requests.
* Develop and maintain a preferred vendor list.
* Safely operate forklifts and vehicles to transport materials as needed.
* Manage main stock inventory, including quarterly checks, inventory counts, and auditor coordination.
* Manage small-tool procurement and tracking by technician and vehicle.
* Stock and prepare vehicles for new hires.
* Assist with purchase order entry and pricing.
* Provide backup support for quote processing, work order processing, invoicing, quoting, and accounts payable invoice processing.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum of three years of experience in the commercial HVAC industry.
* Experience in materials purchasing preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook, and Excel.
* Working knowledge of materials and systems related to the mechanical or HVAC industry.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and follow-up skills.
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* Professional, positive, cooperative, and teachable attitude.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to coordinate multiple activities and meet deadlines.
* Valid driver’s license required; ability to meet company driver qualification standards preferred.
* Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Ability to climb stairs and ladders as needed.
* Ability to stand, squat, bend, and stoop.
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and frequently carry up to 40 pounds unassisted in a warehouse environment.
* Ability to accurately read a ruler or tape measure.
* Ability to work 8- to 10-hour days, maintain a flexible schedule, and work overtime when necessary.
* Some exposure to outdoor weather or elements may be required.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

We believe in investing in our employees and providing opportunities for long-term success. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

* Competitive pay: $23.50 - $29.00 an hour or $48,880 - $60,320 a year
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Growth and development opportunities
* Apprenticeship opportunities with a pathway to licensure

o Four-year technical or business degree or equivalent combinations of technical training and/or related experience. o Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

o Review and issue all purchase requests and SAP orders. Obtain necessary approval(s), review and analyze all reimbursements, requisitions, and Eastman Chemical Company credit card purchases. Review all Tool/Equipment and supplies purchases to ensure accuracy and completeness.

o Assist in scheduling, transport, and payment for Partner equipment service and/or repair.

o Expedite, follow up, and ensure timely delivery of purchase order materials required by all departments. Just-In-Time (JIT) delivery.

o Select products for purchase by testing, observing, or examining items. Estimate value according to knowledge of market price.

o Interface with client and vendors to ensure all purchasing requirements, problems, etc. are addressed/resolved.

o Manage cost saving initiatives. Review and analyze all purchasing documents.

o Ensure all departmental procedures, policies, and work rules are complied with.

o Assist in management and scheduling service of Partner Industrial vehicle fleet.

o Assist in the Partner Cooler Room process as needed.

o Act as backup for the Tool Room Manager during absences to lead employees and maintain processes.

o Perform additional assignments per supervisor’s direction.

o Must be able to comply with all safety regulations and procedures applicable to a chemical plant environment.

o Regular reliable attendance and flexibility to work varied shifts and overtime as needed.

* Vision insurance

Ability to Commute:

* Kingsport, TN 37660 (Required)

Overview:

Herzog Energy, Inc. is currently seeking a **Procurement Coordinator** in **St. Joseph, MO** to join our team and support the growing Procurement and Supply Chain function within Herzog Energy.

The Procurement Coordinator supports the day-to-day administrative, data management, vendor coordination, and purchasing activities necessary to support Herzog Energy's construction projects.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* This is a non-exhaustive overview of the job duties for this position.

* Procurement & Administrative Support: Support the Procurement and Supply Chain Manager with daily purchasing and procurement activities across active and upcoming renewable energy projects, including general administrative duties, special projects, and process improvement initiatives as assigned.
* Records Management: Enter, maintain, and update procurement information within company systems, spreadsheets, and tracking tools.
* Vendor Records: Maintain current vendor contact information, capabilities, certifications, catalogs, and other supplier information.
* Contract Administration Support: Track contract and subcontract status, signatures, revisions, required documentation, and other administrative requirements.
* Invoice Support: Assist with matching invoices to purchase orders and supporting documentation and identify discrepancies for review.
* Reporting: Prepare routine procurement reports and provide accurate information regarding open purchase orders, pending approvals, upcoming deliveries, vendor documentation, and other procurement activities.
* Adhere to established company policies, procedures, terms and conditions, and legal matters that affect purchasing and procurement activities.
* Perform all duties in conformance with appropriate safety policies and procedures.
* Regular and consistent engagement, participation and promotion of Herzog’s Culture and its essential behaviors are a requirement for this position.
* Regular and predictable attendance and punctuality are a requirement for this position.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail are a must.
* Time-management skills are essential; must possess a natural sense of urgency and work well with pressure and deadlines.
* Must be a self-starter and able to excel in a fast-paced environment.
* Flexible and adaptive to change.
* Possess a high level of ingenuity.
* Must have strong interpersonal skills, ability to interact with all levels of employees and prospects.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Products and advanced computer literacy skills.
* Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality

**Pre-Employment Requirements:**

* Subject to pre-employment background check and motor vehicle report review.
* Subject to pre-employment physical, medical evaluation, and drug screen.
* Successfully complete and maintain any required safety certification and testing on an annual basis.

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical demands described below must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential job functions of this role. This is a non-exhaustive overview of the physical requirements for this position.

* Work primarily in an office environment.
* Frequently sits for extended periods of time.
* Frequently use a computer keyboard and office related equipment.
* Requires occasional standing, walking, lifting, stooping or bending.

**Safety:**

* Herzog is nationally recognized for its excellent corporate safety record which results from all employees at all levels, in all positions adhering to established policies and procedures. Reporting any and all safety violations to your immediate supervisor is a prerequisite for continued employment. Safety diligence by all results in a safe work environment for all.

**Benefits:**

* Herzog offers a robust benefits package including medical and dental coverage. The plans are specific to projects and locations.

**Why Herzog:**

Founded in 1969, Herzog is headquartered in St. Joseph, Missouri, with a satellite office in Fort Worth, Texas.

Over the course of our 50+ year history, Herzog has become a national leader in the construction, operations and maintenance of commuter rail, light rail, streetcar, and freight rail projects.

We believe our culture is at the heart of our existence. It is that belief which empowers every member of our professional family to act with purpose and passion as they advance their career throughout their personal pursuit of excellence.

Backed by over five decades of experience, Herzog delivers exceptional customer service and elite results.

Our success is the outcome of our relentless pursuit of excellence, our passion for our customers, safety without compromise, and a deep-rooted belief in the power of team.

We invite you to join us on our journey to excellence as we work to be better today than yesterday and better tomorr

description:
**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Coordinator, based in Las Vegas, NV, plays a pivotal role in managing procurement operations, product research, and vendor negotiations under the direction of the Purchasing Manager. This role is responsible for executing the end-to-end purchasing workflow utilizing enterprise procurement software (SpendMap) to source goods, manage purchase orders, track inventory par levels, and reconcile invoices. By driving strong vendor relationships and aggressive cost negotiation, the Purchasing Coordinator ensures high-quality products and supplies are delivered efficiently to support the luxury operational standards of Paws Up Montana.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Procurement & Order Management:** Enter, process, expedite, and track purchase requests and purchase orders from initial order creation through final delivery using SpendMap.
* **Vendor Negotiations & Cost Control:** Actively research products, conduct three-bid competitive sourcing, and negotiate pricing with suppliers to secure the best possible quality and price for resort supplies.
* **Inventory & Par Level Support:** Assist in maintaining optimal inventory par levels across multiple operational areas, with dedicated focus on guest supplies, small tools, and operational equipment.
* **Vendor Relations & Invoice Reconciliation:** Establish and maintain positive relationships with suppliers and representatives while managing invoice reconciliation and order tracking.

Air Liquide Advanced Materials grows by enabling our customers to innovate. Our ALOHA™ and Voltaix® products are critical to the manufacturer of the newest computer chips required for Big Data and the Internet of Things.

**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

The Purchasing Coordinator is responsible for managing day-to-day procurement operations, including reviewing requisitions, placing purchase orders, and managing vendor relationships for MRO and raw materials. This role focuses on maintaining accurate PO data within ERP systems (preferably SAP), negotiating contract terms within budgetary guidelines, driving cost-reduction initiatives, and cross-functionally resolving invoice and supply chain discrepancies.

**Air Liquide is Hiring for a Purchasing Coordinator!**

**WE ARE LOOKING FOR YOU!**
===========================

* Pay Range: $57k - $72k annually
* Annual bonus: 5%
* Benefits starting on first day
Work Schedule: Hybrid (3 day in office required)

Responsibilities:

* Review purchase requisitions, place purchase orders, and follow up with vendors for MRO and raw materials orders
* Keep pertinent purchase order information up to date within SAP
* Follow up with vendors regarding delivery dates on POs and scheduling releases from blanket orders. Expedites purchases and purchase orders when required.
* Review supplier bid proposals and negotiate contracts within budgetary limitations and scope of authority
* Maintain certifications for pressure vessels and assist Supply Chain team in providing certifications to vendors
* Develop and implement cost reduction ideas for MRO items
* Assist the Purchasing Department staff in vendor sourcing and other projects as required
* Reconcile any purchase order / invoice discrepancies with AP as needed
* Troubleshoot errors within ERP system
* Create new part numbers and assist with the setup of new vendors within ERP system
* Maintain contractor approval documentation and status
* Interfaces with other departments within the organization to resolve issues with purchase orders and purchased items
* Assist with the sourcing of capital items for Engineering, R&D, Product Development, etc.
* Maintenance of Purchasing documents and procedures

**\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_\\_**
----------------------------------------

--------------------

Required Qualifications:

* High School diploma or equivalent

* Strong attention to detail
* 3+ years of experience in Purchasing, Procurement, or Supply Chain
Bachelor's degree in Business or Supply Chain accepted in lieu of relevant work experience

* Strong ERP system experience, especially with SAP
* Chemical or Electronics industry operations experience
* Knowledge of SAP
* Proficiency in Google Suite applications

At Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their background. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

description:
**About BLCCS**

BLCCS, LLC is a San Antonio-based commercial MEP service company providing HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Building Automation & Controls, Energy Services, and Preventive Maintenance.

Founded in 2017, BLCCS supports commercial and mission-critical facilities throughout the San Antonio area. As we continue to grow, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of our tools, inventory, purchasing, vehicle stock, refrigerant tracking, and warehouse operations.

**Position Summary**

The **Inventory, Warehouse & Procurement Coordinator** is responsible for maintaining accurate records of company tools, equipment, materials, vehicle inventory, refrigerant, purchasing, and purchase orders.

This is a hands-on position that combines warehouse responsibilities with administrative and technology-based work. The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable working with technicians and vendors, strong with Excel and technology, and willing to take ownership of processes from start to finish.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain accurate inventory of company tools, equipment, and materials.
* Track tools assigned to employees, vehicles, jobsites, and the warehouse.
* Maintain serial numbers, purchase dates, warranty information, and assignment records.
* Manage tool check-in/check-out and replacement requests.
* Verify warranty or repair options before approving replacement purchases.
* Conduct periodic physical inventory audits.
* Maintain standard vehicle inventory and perform vehicle inventory checks.
* Track refrigerant purchases, technician usage, vehicle stock, and refrigerant logs.
* Reconcile refrigerant inventory and identify discrepancies.
* Create and process purchase orders.
* Purchase approved tools, parts, materials, equipment, and supplies.
* Obtain vendor pricing and availability and follow up on outstanding orders.
* Receive deliveries and verify materials against purchase orders.
* Coordinate returns, damaged materials, and vendor discrepancies.
* Help prevent unnecessary or duplicate purchases.
* Organize warehouse inventory and maintain designated storage locations.
* Prepare materials and equipment for technicians and projects.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized warehouse.

**Position Summary**

The Purchasing Coordinator is responsible for supporting purchasing activities and ensuring ingredients and products are ordered from approved suppliers to meet production needs. This role works closely with internal teams, vendors, and suppliers to support inventory flow, resolve issues, and contribute to cost-effective purchasing practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Purchase ingredients, raw materials, and products from approved suppliers to support scheduled production.
* Monitor production schedules and ensure materials arrive on time to prevent shortages, delays, or overstock.
* Maintain accurate purchase orders, including quantities, pricing, delivery dates, and supplier information.
* Monitor raw material inventory levels using ERP/MRP systems and purchasing tools.
* Maintain purchasing attributes such as safety stock, lead times, reorder points, and purchasing recommendations. Identify opportunities for adjustments and communicate those with the supervisor.
* Daily review for purchasing and inventory reports, including but not limited to the General Item Status Report, Reorder Report, Negative Item Report, and MRP outputs.
* Any discrepancies or issues should be independently researched and assessed prior to escalating to additional stakeholders.
* Communicate professionally with internal departments, vendors, suppliers, and other stakeholders regarding purchasing needs, order status, shortages, supply constraints, and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with Customer Service, Inventory, Receiving, Strategic Procurement, Logistics, Planning, and other teams to support purchasing, inventory flow, and production requirements.
* Support company profitability through cost-effective purchasing, supplier collaboration, cost reduction, cost avoidance, and value-added procurement practices.
* Maintain a strong understanding of manufacturing capabilities, business processes, supply chain operations, and the raw materials used in production.
* Complete other duties and projects as assigned by management.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate degree or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Experience in food, ingredient, manufacturing, or distribution purchasing preferred.
* Experience using ERP/MRP systems or purchasing tools preferred.
* Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, suppliers, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Quality and Food Safety Requirements**

* Follow all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
* Follow all Safe Quality Food (SQF) guidelines.
* Maintain awareness of Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and its importance.
* Ensure all products and ingredients are purchased only from approved suppliers.
* Immediately report food safety problems or concerns to a person with authority to initiate action, as indicated on the organizational chart.

**Safety Requirements**

* Follow applicable OSHA regulations related to job tasks.
* Remain aware of surroundings, including forklift traffic and trip hazards such as pallets or cords when entering production areas.
* Wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when entering production areas.
* Participate in monthly safety engagement activities.

**Company Description**

Rexel USA is one of the largest distributors of electrical products, data communication, wireless communication and related supplies in the United States. Rexel USA operates its electrical distribution business in the United States through eight Regions that go to market under various banner and trade names, including Rexel, Rexel Automation, Gexpro, Mayer, Talley and Platt Electric Supply. In addition to an online store, Rexel USA has a distribution network of over 460 warehouse storefront locations throughout the U.S.

**Job Description**

**We are looking for a Procurement Coordinator to join our Rexel USA team in Mesquite, TX!**

**Summary:**
The Procurement Coordinator is responsible for supporting the Procurement team on day-to-day tasks including monitoring inventory levels, expediting, and scheduling the delivery of purchase orders for inventory replenishment and customer backorders, as well as placing purchase orders when needed. Will work with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure problems are resolved in a timely manner.

**What You'll Do:**

* Support Procurement team with day-to-day tasks including monitoring inventory levels, expediting, and scheduling the delivery of purchase orders for inventory replenishment and customer backorders, as well as placing purchase orders when needed
* Daily review of critical items below minimum, allocations, or stock outs for regional Customer Solution Centers
* Meet or exceed defined fill rate/service level for regional branches and/or assigned supplier lines
* Work with suppliers when there are any shipping issues or discrepancies with product (e.g. non-conformity receipts issues including incorrect items, damaged boxes, quantity differences, poor quality, etc.)
* Assist payable variance resolution with Accounts Payable team when invoice matching issues arise
* Coordinate with warehouse on delivery status of purchase orders and communication to and from suppliers and freight forwarders on expedited shipment dates
* Monitor and push out communication on expedited shipments and updates from suppliers to sales teams and into ERP system
* Interface with multiple departments and resolve problems and issue as necessary
* Analyze and manage unhealthy inventory by updating stock flags, reviewing item minimums, and coordinating excess inventory transfers back to the Customer Solution Center
* Assist Inventory Planner with negotiations and execution of supplier returns
* Other duties as assigned

**Job Duties Disclaimer:**
The information contained in this job description is intended to describe the essential job functions required of those assigned to this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform the job. Please note that management retains the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrate commitment to effective customer service delivery, integrity, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Rexel USA.

**Qualifications**

**What You'll Need**

* 2+ years of procurement experience preferred
* Prior experience in the electrical distribution industry preferred
* High School or GED - Required

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Excellent computer skills including Microsoft Office products
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with partners at all levels
* Be a self-starter
* Attention to detail
* Excellent time management skills
* Ability to prioritize and organize

**Additional Information**

**Physical Demands:**

* Sit: Must be able to remain in a stationary position - Constantly – at least 51%
* Walk: Must be able to move about inside/outside office or work location - Frequently – 21% to 50%
* Use hands to finger, handle, or feel: Operates a computer and other office machinery - Constantly – at least 51%
* Stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl: Must be able to crouch down to stock shelves, pick up boxes, or position oneself to maintain computers in the lab/under desks/in server closet - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Climb or balance: Must be able to ascend/descend on a ladder, forklift, pallet jack, or other warehouse equipment - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Talk, hear, taste, smell: Must be able to use senses to effectively communicate with co-workers and clients and detect hazardous conditions - Constantly – at least 51%

**Weight and Force Demands:**

* Up to 10 pounds - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Up to 25 pounds - Occasionally – up to 20%

**Working Environment:**

* Exposed to unpleasant or disagreeable physical environment such as high noise level and/or exposure to heat and cold - Occasionally – up to 20%
* Travels to offsite locations

Plantain Products Company - Chifles, the number one plantain chip brand in the U.S. by dollar sales, is hiring a Logistics and Procurement Coordinator in Miami-Dade. You will own daily freight quoting and booking, shipment coordination, purchase orders for packaging, racks and displays, and fleet compliance scheduling. Execution done well and done reliably, reporting to the Director of Operations and Logistics.

This role keeps product moving and orders flowing every day. This is an individual contributor role; it does not manage people.

**Full-time, on-site.** Pay is $60,000 to $75,000 per year. Benefits include health insurance, a 401(k) match and paid time off.

**First 90 days**

* Take over daily logistics and purchasing through a 90-day handover, working beside the people who run it today.
* Run the freight quoting cycle and the weekly delivery schedule without supervision.
* Keep the carrier and supplier scorecard current.

**How we evaluate**

A conversation, then a practical exercise based on real logistics and purchasing work. Details are shared with candidates who move forward.

Chifles is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic.

**Compensation:**

$60,000 - $75,000 yearly

**Responsibilities:**

**Freight and daily logistics**

* Freight quoting and carrier booking, the largest single piece of the job. Solicit and compare FTL and LTL rates daily across our broker and carrier bench, hold a lane to a ceiling, and book.
* Live shipment coordination and exceptions: bills of lading and corrections, pickup confirmations and reschedules, trailer status, refused shipments, damage and shortage claims.
* Retailer purchase order cross-check, near daily, across our club and retail accounts: read each incoming PO against what was quoted and what will ship, and catch the leakage before it becomes a deduction. Order entry itself sits with the customer service team.
* Build and publish the weekly DSD delivery schedule to our independent distributor network and the internal sales and operations team.
* Purchase order reconciliation with brokers, mapping retailer PO lines and ship dates to SKUs.
* Packaging and inbound supplier documentation, including case and state-specific label specifications and inbound container paperwork.
* Share ship dates and order volumes with the warehouse team so it can plan the week.

**Purchase orders and follow-through**

* Place and manage purchase orders for film, packaging and other non-fruit inputs, tracking lead times and reorder points against the production plan.
* Own rack and display purchasing end to end: quantities against the program, lead times, delivery to the plant, and the paperwork behind each order.
* Approve packaging box purchase orders prepared by the warehouse team before they are sent.
* Keep the carrier and supplier scorecard current: on-time-in-full, fill rate, cost variance against quote.
* Check carrier invoices against the quoted rate and flag every variance.
* Work inside the freight and spend limits the Director sets, and escalate above them.
* Oversee the weekly inventory reconciliation in the ERP: check that each category owner completed their count, follow up on the ones that did not, and escalate variances.
* Handle day-to-day operational exceptions, including some outside normal hours.

**Fleet**

* DOT compliance for our trucks and drivers: files, inspections, renewals and the calendar behind them. Low frequency, zero tolerance for a lapse.
* Truck and trailer maintenance scheduling across owned and leased units, so a unit out of service never surprises the delivery schedule.

**Qualifications:**

* 2 to 4 years in logistics, freight, shipping or purchasing, in food, CPG, distribution or manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience booking FTL and LTL freight and working with brokers and carriers.
* Comfortable working inside an ERP rather than around it in spreadsheets. Acumatica experience is a plus.
* Solid Excel, and the care to keep a running scorecard accurate.
* Demonstrated AI proficiency. A requirement, not a preference. We use AI tools daily across the company, and you will be expected to do the same.
* Bilingual, Spanish and English. Much of the plant floor and warehouse work in Spanish.
* Organized under load, and willing to chase a carrier until you get an answer.

**About Company**

Plantain Products Company - Chifles is the number one plantain chip brand in the United States by dollar sales. We are family-owned, with about 65 employees. Our Miami operation bags cooked chips that arrive in bulk from our suppliers and builds the displays that ship to clubs and retailers. Our product moves through national retailers, warehouse clubs, a Florida DSD route network, and independent distributors.

**Senior Procurement Coordinator**
==================================

**Location:** On Site at Salt Lake City, UT **Employment Type:** Full-Time **Pay Type:** Salary **Reports To:** Head of Group Procurement

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Procurement Coordinator to manage sourcing, purchasing, supplier relations, and inventory alignment across six store-front locations. This role will serve as the central point of coordination for purchasing operations and will utilize Odoo ERP to track demand, manage purchase orders, optimize inventory, and ensure cost-effective buying decisions. The ideal candidate has strong experience in multi-location procurement, vendor performance management, and data-driven purchasing using Odoo or similar ERP. Coatings and construction materials background is considered a plus.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

PurchasingProcurement Execution

* Create, track, and manage purchase orders in Odoo ERP across six storefronts
* Consolidate purchasing needs across locations to leverage volume and pricing
* Ensure timely replenishment based on reorder points, safety stock, and demand forecasts
* Conduct competitive price reviews and cost benchmarking

ERPData Management

* Maintain accurate supplier catalogs, lead times, and pricing in Odoo
* Monitor product availability, landed cost, and purchase history
* Generate procurement and spend visibility reports in Odoo
* Support system improvements, workflow automation, and purchasing dashboards

VendorSupply Chain Management

* Build and maintain supplier relationships to ensure reliability and service quality
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules
* Resolve backorders, shortages, and quality issues
* Evaluate supplier performance using KPIs (on-time delivery, cost variance, defect rate)

Cross-Location Coordination

* Collaborate with store managers to validate demand planning and inventory needs
* Standardize SKUs and purchasing specifications to reduce complexity
* Participate in product substitutions and sourcing alternatives when needed
* Support logistics coordination and delivery routing for multiple locations

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3-5+ years of procurement, purchasing, or supply chain coordination experience
* Experience working with ERPs (plus)
* Strong understanding of purchase planning, inventory controls, and vendor negotiations
* Excellent Excel or ERP-based reporting skills
* Strong communication skills and high attention to detail
* Multi-location procurement experience preferred

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* ERP-based decision making
* Negotiation and supplier management
* Time-sensitive problem solving
* Cost awareness and continuous improvement mindset
* Process documentation / standardization
* Ownership and accountability
* ISO
* LEAN

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelors in a Business, Engineering, or Economics concertation required
* Masters degree preferred

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation
* Growth opportunities in procurement / supply chain
* Exposure to multi-location operations and ERP optimization
* Matching 401K
* Full Insurance package available
* PTO

**\\*\\*Applicant must reside in Northeast Ohio**

Join the Cleveland Clinic team where you will work alongside passionate caregivers and make a lasting, meaningful impact on patient care. Here, you will receive endless support and appreciation while building a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.

At Cleveland Clinic's Transplant Center, experts perform a variety of transplantation procedures. Each year, thousands of lives are saved and transformed because of our innovative expertise. As Donor Procurement Coordinator, you will coordinate all activities related to the receipt of organ offers for transplant, evaluation of organ offers for suitability, procurement of organs and transplant set-ups. Your position is essential to the organization and functioning of the Transplant Center, allowing caregivers to supply patients with the necessary treatment they need.

**This is a remote role. A caregiver in this position works varying 12hr shifts on a day/night rotation.**

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

* Comply with OPTN/UNOS requirements for post-transplant documentation of donor and transplant activities.

* Serve as the contact for all potential offers for transplant from local, regional and national organ procurement organizations.

* Organize the procurement team and dispatch team to the donor site within the required time frame.

* Coordinate air or ground transportation of organs.

* Serve as a resource for organ recovery and preservation.

* Assist in training organ preservation caregivers.

* Orient new residents and fellows to renal procurement, renal allocation and regulatory requirements.

* Develop and present professional education programs as needed.

* Obtain, analyze and report pertinent data regarding potential donors and accepted organs for transplants.

* Attend selection committee meetings.

* Abstract data and enter data into the transplant database.

* Maintain valid licensure and required certificates (Registered Nurse, Registered Respiratory Therapist or Emergency Medical Technician – Paramedic).

Minimum qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

* Bachelor’s Degree in a science-related field OR a degree/diploma from an accredited Nursing School, Respiratory Therapy Program or Paramedic Program

* One year of experience as an organ procurement coordinator OR clinical experience in critical care or in the field of organ procurement/transplant

* Maintain valid licenses and required certificates (Registered Nurse, Respiratory Therapist or Emergency Medical Technician – Paramedic)

Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

* Certified Procurement Transplant Coordinator (CPTC) by the American Board for Transplant Certification (ABTC)
* Previous transplant or organ procurement experience

* Related healthcare experience, UNOS/UNET experience and knowledge

**Physical Requirements:**

* Clinical, Exposure to Risk. Ability to be available 24 hours a day when assigned.

**Personal Protective Equipment:**

* Follows standard precautions using personal protective equipment as required.

**Pay Range**

Minimum Annual Salary: $57,510.00

Maximum Annual Salary: $87,697.50

The pay range displayed on this job posting reflects the anticipated range for new hires. A successful candidate’s actual compensation will be determined after taking factors into consideration such as the candidate’s work history, experience, skill set and education. The pay range displayed does not include any applicable pay practices (e.g., shift differentials, overtime, etc.). The pay range does not include the value of Cleveland Clinic’s benefits package (e.g., healthcare, dental and vision benefits, retirement savings account contributions, etc.).
