**Company Description**

Aspen One renews the mind, body, and spirit with a portfolio that redefines luxury, adventure, and leisure. With world-class and innovative brands and businesses, including Aspen Skiing Company, Aspen Hospitality, and Aspen Ventures, Aspen One propels the expansion of the Aspen ethos globally.

Whether it's Aspen Skiing Company providing unforgettable experiences at the confluence of nature, culture, and recreation across its four legendary mountains—Aspen Mountain, Snowmass, Aspen Highlands, and Buttermilk; or Aspen Hospitality elevating guest experiences in unforgettable ways by developing, owning, and operating a growing set of luxury and upper-scale hotels, private clubs, and branded residential properties in prime locations under The Nell and Limelight brands; Aspen One is deeply committed to providing unparalleled service, creative programming, community engagement, and unique opportunities for exploration. The company’s commitment to innovation is central to its evolution, including Aspen Ventures' amplification of the Aspen brand globally through new business lines that embody its values and heritage such as Aspen Collection.

For more than 75 years, the Aspen brand and community has pointed its compass toward new paths, people, and possibilities—and today, as Aspen One, the future is limitless. The company is a leader in sustainability and advocacy, with a legacy of modeling leading-edge solutions and changing policy locally and globally. As a collection of brands driven by tightly held core values, Aspen One aims to inspire a better world. For more information, visit www.aspen.com.

Please note that all official communications from the Talent Acquisition or Human Resources team are sent from email addresses within the notifications@smartrecruiters.com, aspen.com, aspensnowmass.com, aspenhospitality.co, limelighthotels.com & thelittlenell.com domains.

**Job Description**

**Position Summary**

The Procurement Coordinator supports purchasing operations for both the ski resort and hotel divisions by ensuring timely, cost‑effective sourcing of goods, supplies, and services. Working within the Coupa, this role manages purchase orders, vendor communication, and inventory tracking to keep operational departments stocked and functioning smoothly. The Procurement Coordinator helps maintain high service standards by coordinating purchasing workflows that meet the unique needs of mountain operations and hospitality environments. This position reports to the Senior Director of Procurement.

The hourly pay range for this position is $24.50-29.00. Actual pay will be dependent on budget and experience.

**Job Posting Deadline**

Applications for this position will be accepted until October 19, 2026.

**Essential Job Functions/Key Job Responsibilities**

* Process purchase requests and generate purchase orders in accordance with company policies and spending guidelines
* Coordinate with department leaders across resort and hotel operations to identify purchasing needs and timelines
* Communicate with vendors to obtain quotes, confirm pricing, track shipments, and resolve delivery issues
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, documentation, and data entry within procurement systems
* Monitor inventory levels and assist with stock replenishment for key operational categories such as F&B, housekeeping, retail, and mountain supplies
* Support vendor onboarding, ensuring proper completion of agreements, compliance documents, and account setup
* Assist in negotiating pricing, order quantities, and delivery schedules under the guidance of procurement leadership
* Verify receipts of goods and review invoices for accuracy before submitting for payment processing
* Help coordinate seasonal ordering cycles
* Prepare purchasing reports and updates to support forecasting, budgeting, and departmental planning
* Maintain positive working relationships with internal teams, external vendors, and logistics partners
* Identify opportunities to streamline purchasing workflows and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency
* Performs other related tasks as assigned

**Qualifications**

**Education & Experience Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or Hospitality preferred
* 1–2 years of purchasing, inventory management, administrative support, or hospitality operations experience
* 1+ years of experience using Coupa strongly preferred
* Experience working in resort, hotel, or multi‑department operational environments preferred

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Understanding of supply chain and inventory management systems
* Strong communication skills, using various channels (oral, written, presentations) to various internal and external audiences
* Ability to collaborate with internal and external groups and individuals effectively
* Proficient computer skills including working knowledge of Coupa and Microsoft Sui

At Prisma, formerly Vivid Ink, we rely on a meticulous financial system to drive business forward. Purchasing keeps that system running smoothly by purchasing both raw materials and subcontracted items on a timely basis. The purchasing coordinatore will have interaction with operations and accounting.

**Responsibilities:**

* Purchase raw materials and subcontracted items.
* Track cost and inventory on raw material items
* Ensure the raw materials are in stock as needed.
* Understands operations issues around the purchasing processes

**Qualifications/Skills:**

* Proven work experience in purchasing.
* Data entry skills
* Strong communication, problem solving and analytical skills required
* Ability to work independently.

**The Mission**
To communicate and assist with Procurement Director, Field Department, and outside growers/suppliers/drivers to deliver high quality raw materials to the Stahlbush processing plant. This role covers the documentation, planning, and coordination required to deliver materials in compliance with sustainable, organic, GAP, FSMA, SQF, DOT, and any other required 3rd party audit or process.
**Reporting Relationships**
This position will report directly to the Director of Procurement. The employee will work closely with multiple departments throughout the company along with outside growers/suppliers/contractors.
**Outcomes**

* Proactively resolve any issues related to raw product quality or delivery in a thorough and timely manner.
* Conduct internal audits of documentation to ensure compliance with third-party certification standards.
* Complete weight sheets for received products, ensuring all data aligns with traceability standards and providing accurate reports to Accounts Payable.
* Work with Procurement team to create and negotiate contracts with outside suppliers and growers to secure raw materials.
* Become an expert in our internal Transportation Management System (LOADS) to assist in transportation responsibilities, including creating, editing, and checking in shipments.
* Request freight quotes and issue Purchase Orders (POs) for inbound raw materials using the SIFI LOADS program and schedule shipments with vendors.
* Coordinate outside contract drivers and brokers to facilitate harvested crops for delivery to the processing plant.
* Assist the Field Department in pulling crop, soil, and moisture samples from the field.
* Assist in the maintenance and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and specifications for raw products.
* Assist in DMV and DOT related tasks, including vehicle registrations, insurance cards, and overweight/over-width permits.
* Support and optimize Stahlbush sustainability initiatives to align with company mission statement.
* This position has been identified as holding responsibility for food safety and quality of the company. This responsibility extends over all shifts.
* During the absence, the following position serves as coverage to this position: Director of Procurement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Agriculture, or related field preferred
* Passion to pursue a career in the agricultural, supply chain, or food production industry
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs including Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word
* Ability and willingness to work independently and improve processes
* Proficiency in procurement processes, vendor negotiations, and contract management
* Basic understanding of farming practices and the nature of the industry
* Willingness to learn current market pricing, food safety, and agriculture certifications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Working Conditions**
General office environment with minimal physical effort. Requires sitting at a desk for majority of workday, but when needed, there will be periods of time work is performed outside.

description:
**Job Title:** Procurement Coordinator

**Location:** Richmond or Staunton, VA

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Travel:** 5%–25%, domestic and international

**Compensation:** $75,000–$90,000 annually

**Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA with employer contributions, employer-paid Life/AD&D, employer-paid Short-Term Disability, and voluntary supplemental insurance options

**Job Summary**

Our client is seeking an experienced Procurement Coordinator to support and manage purchasing, sourcing, logistics, inventory, and supplier performance. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining effective supply chain processes that improve operational efficiency, control costs, maintain appropriate inventory levels, and support reliable product availability.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in purchasing and supply chain operations, including international sourcing, importing, supplier management, contracting, lean processes, and continuous improvement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review and update supply chain policies and procedures to comply with new or changing environmental policies, standards, regulations, and laws, including Proposition 65 and other location-specific requirements.
* Maximize inventory and working capital turns by developing suppliers with shorter delivery cycles, improved reliability, and smaller order quantities while maintaining appropriate safety stock levels and avoiding stockouts.
* Manage supplier quality and performance issues through the Supplier Corrective Action process.
* Maintain documentation and records of supplier issues, resolutions, corrective actions, and related communications.
* Participate in the customer complaint review process and remain informed of relevant customer complaints.
* Develop procedures to effectively coordinate supply chain activities with sales, marketing, finance, production, quality assurance, and other functional areas.
* Design and implement supply chain strategies that support overall business objectives.
* Adapt supply chain strategies in response to changing market conditions, new business opportunities, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve supplier performance, operational efficiency, and overall supply chain effectiveness.
* Support company objectives and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
* Model and uphold company values in daily responsibilities and interactions.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in purchasing, supply chain management, and logistics.
* Extensive experience with international supply chain management, importing, and global sourcing.
* Strong understanding of lean and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing lean business processes within an international supply base.
* Thorough understanding of legal contracting and supplier agreements.
* Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Proven ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with vendors, suppliers, shippers, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong financial analysis skills and a goal-oriented approach.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
* Valid driver’s license.
* Valid U.S. passport.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 5%–25% of the time.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success improving inventory turns, supplier lead times, reliability, and purchasing efficiency.
* Experience managing supplier corrective actions and supplier quality issues.
* Experience working with environmental and product compliance requirements, including Proposition 65.
* Experience collaborating across sales, marketing, finance, production, and quality assurance functions.

**Work Environment / Schedule**

* Position is based in Richmond or Staunton, VA.
* May require extended periods of sitting at a desk, typing, and standing.
* Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-stress environment.
* May periodically work in construction or warehouse environments.
* Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds.
* Must adhere to the our clients Health & Safety Manual.
* Attendance at company safety meetings and participation in safety drills are required.
* Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn when applicable.
* Domestic and international travel may account for approximately 5%–25% of the role.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual salary range of $75,000–$90,000.
* Multiple Aetna medical plan options, including HSA-eligible plans.
* Dental coverage through Aetna.
* Voluntary vision coverage through Guardian.

* Ability to analyze inventory trends and purchasing needs.
* Strong negotiation and cost-control skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments.
* Excellent recordkeeping and documentation skills.

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift and move items up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to work in a warehouse or office environment as needed.

* Maintain adequate inventory levels to support company operations.

description:
Fisher Industries is a vertically integrated family of businesses that provides heavy civil construction and aggregate products across the United States. With over 70 years of experience, the company specializes in highways, bridges, aggregates, and large-scale infrastructure projects, supported by in-house capabilities in drilling, blasting, crushing, asphalt, and concrete production. Fisher is committed to delivering innovative, cost-effective solutions with an emphasis on safety and quality. As a proven industry leader, Fisher Industries continues to grow while maintaining the integrity and values of a family-owned company. For additional information about our company, visit our website at www.fisherind.com

**POSITION SCOPE**

The **Parts & Procurement Coordinator** serves as the central communication and coordination hub between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, vendors, and management. This role is responsible for managing procurement request intake, tracking request status, prioritizing operational needs, maintaining procurement records, and ensuring timely communication throughout the purchasing process. By centralizing request management and status reporting, this position allows Procurement Specialists to focus on sourcing, purchasing, vendor management, and expediting activities that support critical construction, aggregate, and equipment operations.

**PRIMARY DUTIES**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming parts, material, and procurement requests from field personnel, supervisors, project managers, mechanics, and operational teams.
* Manage a high volume of incoming communications and procurement-related requests daily.
* Create, document, and maintain procurement requests and work orders within department tracking systems and dashboards.
* Capture and verify required request details including equipment numbers, project information, quantities, priorities, delivery locations, and required completion dates.
* Review requests for accuracy and completeness and route them to the appropriate Procurement Specialist based on business segment, equipment type, or operational need.
* Prioritize requests based on equipment downtime, project schedules, operational urgency, and management direction.
* Maintain current status information for active procurement requests and provide updates to requesting departments.
* Communicate estimated delivery dates, shipment tracking information, backorders, delays, substitutions, and order status updates.
* Escalate urgent, delayed, or stalled requests to Procurement Specialists or department leadership as necessary.
* Track procurement requests from initial intake through completion and verify accurate closeout documentation.
* Coordinate parts and material pickups, transfers, and deliveries with warehouse personnel, drivers, and field teams.
* Maintain organized records including quotes, purchase orders, invoices, tracking information, vendor communications, and procurement documentation.
* Maintain current vendor and supplier contact information and identify potential duplicate requests or communication gaps.
* Document emergency purchases and after-hours procurement activity.
* Prepare and distribute procurement status reports for department leadership and operational stakeholders.
* Assist Procurement Specialists with administrative and reporting responsibilities during periods of high purchasing volume.
* Maintain effective communication between Field Operations, Procurement, Warehouse personnel, and delivery teams.
* Promote safety, efficiency, and teamwork across all business operations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* High school diploma or GED required; associate degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or related field preferred.
* Previous experience in procurement coordination, purchasing support, parts administration, inventory control, construction operations, fleet maintenance, or related field preferred.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
* Experience with purchasing, inventory, ERP, fleet management, or work-order tracking systems preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively with personnel at all organizational levels, vendors, and external partners.
* Knowledge of heavy equipment, construction, aggregate production, trucking, or fleet operations preferred.

Fisher Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are a drug-free work environment requiring pre-employment and random drug testing.

If you require an accommodation with applying, please email hrdept@fisherind.com or call the HR Department at (701) 456-9184 to request accommodations. This email is only to request accommodation for

description:
**Purchasing Coordinator**

**Join Our Team:**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive **Purchasing Coordinator** to join our growing team. This role is responsible for managing the purchasing process from order placement through fulfillment, building strong vendor relationships, negotiating competitive pricing, and ensuring timely delivery of products. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and excels at coordinating with suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

If you are highly organized, customer-focused, and enjoy working with vendors and sales teams to keep operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Create, process, and manage purchase orders with suppliers, vendors, and manufacturers.
* Coordinate product procurement and fulfillment to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers to maximize value and cost savings.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and manufacturers while monitoring supplier performance.
* Track and follow up on order status, shipments, backorders, and delivery schedules.
* Process and distribute purchase orders, invoices, and related purchasing documentation.
* Review and analyze purchasing reports and ad hoc data to support business decisions.
* Ensure customer requirements are accurately communicated and executed, including:
+ Product specifications and configurations
+ Quantity increases or decreases
+ Split shipments and multiple orders
+ Special customer requirements
+ Multiple shipping locations
* Serve as a liaison between suppliers, customers, sales teams, and internal departments regarding order status, updates, delays, and fulfillment issues.
* Resolve purchasing and fulfillment discrepancies while maintaining a high level of customer service.
* Maintain accurate records and data within company systems and purchasing platforms.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel and Word.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred/Not Required:**

* Experience in purchasing, procurement, order management, supply chain, inside sales support, or related roles.
* Knowledge of IT, technology, or Audio Visual (AV) products and solutions.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Quosal, or similar platforms.
* Experience negotiating pricing and managing vendor relationships.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A sense of urgency and ownership.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* A customer-first mindset.
* The ability to build productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A commitment to accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

About Golden Star Technology (GST)
Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Cerritos, CA, Golden Star Technology (GST) is a leading provider of IT and AV solutions, serving businesses, enterprise organizations, educational institutions, and government agencies nationwide. Through strategic partnerships with industry-leading technology manufacturers, GST delivers innovative solutions, customized services, and exceptional customer support.

Recognized by the Los Angeles Business Journal as one of LA's Best Places to Work for seven consecutive years, GST has also earned numerous industry awards and accolades for excellence, growth, innovation, and customer service. Our success is driven by a commitment to teamwork, integrity, accountability, and continuous professional development.

For more information, please visit www.gstinc.com

**CordenPharma** is a leading full-service Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), excipients, drug products (DPs), and packaging. With around 3,000 employees worldwide, we help pharmaceutical and biotech companies manufacture medicines with the ultimate goal of improving people’s lives.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Our network, spanning Europe and the U.S., provides flexible and specialized solutions across six technology platforms: Peptides, Lipids & Carbohydrates, Injectables, Highly Potent & Oncology, Small Molecules, and Oligonucleotides. We strive for excellence in supporting this network and are committed to delivering the highest quality products for patient well-being.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our People Vision**
---------------------

We strive for excellence. We share our passion. Together, we make a difference in patients' lives.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------

The Procurement Coordinator partners closely with Procurement to execute purchasing needs while maintaining strong visibility into departmental budgets and ensuring compliance with internal policies, MAS requirements, and audit controls. Serves as the primary point of contact for all procurement-related activities within an assigned department. Detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of collaborating cross-functionally to support efficient and compliant procurement operations.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

**Procurement Coordination**

* Serve as the central intake point for departmental purchasing requests
* Work with stakeholders to understand required goods/services, timing, and priorities
* Partner with Procurement to ensure sourcing and purchasing align with established processes

**Cost Center & Budget Support**

* Act as the Procurement Coordinator for the assigned department
* Maintain working knowledge of:
+ Budget structure and approved spending by G/L Account
+ Current commitments and anticipated purchasing needs
* Support alignment between purchasing activity and approved budgets

**SAP Requisitioning**

* Create and manage purchase requisitions in SAP
* Ensure accurate cost center and G/L coding, proper documentation, and MAS adherence

**Receipt & Acceptance**

* Acknowledge receipt and acceptance of goods and services
* Confirm deliveries align with purchase order requirements
* Complete receiving confirmations in SAP to support timely invoice processing
* Coordinate resolution of delivery or receiving discrepancies

**Policy & Compliance**

* Ensure all purchasing and receiving activities comply with procurement policies, MAS requirements, and audit standards
* Escalate exceptions or questions to Procurement as needed

**P-Card Management**

* Utilize a corporate P-Card for purchases not processed through SAP
* Ensure proper documentation, reconciliation, and compliance with P-Card policies

**LEADERSHIP & BUDGET RESPONSIBILITIES**
----------------------------------------

None.

**SAFETY & ENVIRONMENTAL RESPONSIBILITIES**
-------------------------------------------

Every individual is personally responsible for the safety and environmental aspects of their activities in the workplace. Each employee is expected to perform their job duties in a safe manner utilizing all their knowledge, training, ability, and experience.

**QUALITY RESPONSIBILITIES**
----------------------------

Corden Pharma Colorado (CPC) is a manufacturer of a variety of pharmaceutical products. In following Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), Corden Pharma Colorado manufactures in accordance with the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA), International Council for Harmonisation Q7 (ICH), and other global regulations as applicable. This is critical as it is our mission to not place patients at risk due to inadequate safety, quality, or efficacy. CPC’s Quality Management System, which incorporates cGMP, is designed to deliver this quality objective. description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As a Procurement Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting procurement operations and cross-functional business activities to ensure materials, services, and resources are available when and where they are needed. This position provides administrative and operational support to the Procurement team while partnering with multiple departments to drive efficient purchasing processes, inventory accuracy, equipment maintenance coordination, facility initiatives, and operational continuity.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

* Support procurement activities by preparing and issuing Requests for Quotation (RFQs) and organizing supplier quotations for review and analysis.
* Assist procurement team members with purchasing activities to support customer sales, repair, and operational requirements.
* Create, process, and maintain purchase orders for direct materials, indirect materials, tooling, maintenance, repair services, and other business needs.
* Support Bill of Materials (BOM) purchasing activities to ensure timely availability of required components.
* Maintain inventory-related data and assist with inventory management initiatives to support operational objectives.
* Provide administrative and transactional support to Procurement Buyers, including data entry, supplier information maintenance, pricing updates, virtual inventory management, and system record accuracy.
* Coordinate equipment and machine maintenance service requests in partnership with production leadership and service providers.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across manufacturing, operations, facilities, shipping and receiving, and other functional teams to support business initiatives and continuous improvement projects.
* Assist in the planning and coordination of company events and facility-related improvement activities.
* Provide backup support for shipping and receiving operations, as required.
* Gather and analyze information to support procurement decisions, recommendations, and special projects.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procurement procedures, quality standards, and applicable business requirements.
Participate in continuous improvement activities that enhance efficiency, service levels, and operational effectiveness.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to analyze information, exercise sound judgment, and make recommendations based on available data.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Customer-focused mindset with the ability to provide responsive support to internal stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to work independently while contributing as an engaged team member.
* Solutions-oriented approach with a willingness to learn and continuously improve.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and adapt to changing business needs.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Experience with ERP systems and account management databases preferred; Epicor experience is a plus.

### **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, inventory management, customer service, or administrative support preferred.
Manufacturing environment experience is a plus.

**BENEFITS WITH JABIL**
-----------------------

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
* 401(k) Match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
* Commuter Benefits
* Employee Assistance Program
* Pet Insurance
* Adoption Assistance
* Annual Merit Increases
* Community Volunteer Opportunities

description:
**Role Description**: Entry Level Purchasing Assistant

**Company Background**

Denier Electric is a family-owned business with a rich history that goes back over 8 decades. The business started as a small electrical contractor business in 1942 and has grown into a multi-division business capable of meeting the needs of just about any construction project. We are a regional leader amongst our peers specializing in commercial, mission critical, multi-family housing, healthcare, institutional and specialty electrical projects.

Denier is seeking eager, hardworking individuals to join our team. If you have a dedicated work ethic and enjoy working in a safety-focused, productive team environment this job is for you.

**Opportunity**

Denier is looking to expand our Purchasing team with an entry level Purchasing Agent. Experience in the electrical distribution or contracting business is preferred but not required.

**Job Responsibilities & Requirements**

* Solicit quotes for product/material needed
* Issue and process purchase orders for product/material
* Data entry, monitoring, and tracking of purchase orders, including back orders
* Inspect product/material in the warehouse
* Infrequent light warehouse duties
* Basic computer skills using Microsoft Word and Excel

**Skills**

* Ability to work well with others in a team oriented environment
* Self-motivated with a willingness to learn
* Punctual

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Pay
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401K with a Company match
* A fully paid medical plan.
* Dental and vision insurance available
* Provided Short-Term Disability
* Long-Term Disability available
* Provided Basic Life Insurance
* Supplemental Life Insurance available

Visit our website at www.denier.com to learn more about us and email your resume to our Human Resources Department at HR@denier.com.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

-------------------

The ideal assistant buyer is analytical, results-oriented and views the business through the lens of the customer.

**A day in the life…**

* Develop an understanding of the needs, wants and expectations of the customer
* Build an understanding of the market and competitors in their category
* Establish a clear understanding of the seasonal department merchandise strategy
* Partner with assistant buy planner on market preparation
* Contribute to negotiations of exclusive offerings, terms, pricing, vendor funded markdowns, return-to-vendor agreements, drop-ship programs, co-op, etc.
* Function as liaison to online and/or stores as assigned; including effective communication of the selling agenda
* Contribute to inventory management in season; including driving markdowns and exit strategy
* Be a student of the business regarding effective analysis and decision making to improve department performance
* Collaborate with, and respond with a sense of urgency to regional merchandisers regarding customer needs
* Partner with assistant buy planner to improve the depth and precision of location-level inventory content
* Participate in business reviews to develop greater understanding of how specific actions impact overall department results

**You own this if you have...**

* Bachelor's degree in Merchandising or equivalent work experience
* Experience in retail merchandising, planning or analysis required
* Experience supporting a high sales volume category (high SKU count, heavy seasonality, high revenue ($20M+) preferred

description:
**General Summary**

Claire’s is being remade as a modern playground for girlhood, designed for Gen Alpha girls across the U.S. and Canada. While so many brands are trying to pull her toward what’s next, Claire’s is built around who she is right now—a place where she can explore, make choices, and build confidence. Claire’s has pierced more than 131 million customers, and for many girls, it is the first store where they spend their own money on something they chose for themselves. Our strategy is to build the products, experiences, and stores around those choices, giving her reasons to come back at every stage of girlhood. That work is happening now across piercing and jewelry, beauty, accessories, and toys. The Assistant Buyer is involved from the very beginning. You’ll follow product from first sample to store, sit in the room where the assortment is shaped, and look at the weekly data to understand what she picked up, what she passed on, and why. Your decisions reach 900 stores and you can walk into one and see your work come to life on the sales floor. In your first year, success means becoming the person in the room who knows your product area better than anyone else and turns weekly reads into actions the team can use. From there, your ownership grows—from the size of the business you manage to the decisions you make independently. Every merchant is reviewed twice a year on performance and potential, with development plans tied directly to what’s required for the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

Analyze and report on your area weekly and provide tactical in season trading actions to drive the business forward.
Build expertise in the customer and the competition for the assigned department, including other retailers' assortments, pricing and promotions against Claire's, and report back findings, white space opportunities and actions.
Track assigned tests cleanly: matched doors, matched weeks, and per-department reads, so scale, extend or exit decisions rest on actuals.
Use retail math to analyze the department weekly, monthly and seasonally, provide accurate investment inputs, and explain item level sales, margin and inventory variances, escalating errors and emerging risks.
Create and maintain style boards and line sheets with the product detail cross-functional partners need.
Manage the sample process: sort styles by category and season, track every sample against requirements, and communicate product changes before shipment.
Develop and maintain cross-functional relationships with Design, Product Development, Sourcing, Planning, Allocation, Marketing and In Store Presentation to learn the seasonal buying process.
Support the Buyer and the merchandising team on day-to-day functions for the assigned departments.
Own administrative deliverables: meeting reports and recaps, purchase orders, submits, sample tracking and seasonal buy recaps, keeping the critical path on time and the information accurate.
Manage email correspondence efficiently, escalate concerns to the merchandising team, and meet deadlines without a reminder.

**Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in fashion merchandising, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Experience in retail or merchandise buying preferred
Curiosity about the customer we serve and what she is choosing right now
Comfort with numbers, including retail math, and the instinct to ask what a number means rather than only report it
Organized enough to hold a critical path on time without being chased
Clear written and verbal communication, including with partners outside merchandising
Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint)

Claire’s is committed to adhering to all applicable company policies and federal, state, and local laws and regulations. All positions will be compensated at or above the legally mandated minimum wage for the location in which work is performed. The final compensation will be determined by various factors such as relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

Benefits for full-time employees included medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary welfare plans, bonus plan eligibility, 401(k) match, vacation time, sick time\\* and paid leave.

Benefits for part-time employees included voluntary welfare plans, 401(k) match, vacation time, sick time\\* and paid leave in required states.

* Sick Time: For the State of Washington, all employees will accrue paid sick time at the rate of 1 hour for every 30 hours worked.

Claire's is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and we encourage applications from members of all underrepresented groups, including those with disabilities. We will accommodate applicants' needs, upon request, throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Please inform us of the accommodation(s) that you may require.

Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confide

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

This position provides administrative, organizational, and operational support to the Purchasing Department. The role coordinates daily office activities, maintains documentation and contract files, supports contract intake and routing, and ensures clear, timely communication with internal stakeholders and external vendors. As a backup Buyer, the position assists with purchasing tasks, including preparing requisitions and purchase orders, obtaining quotes per policy thresholds, following up with suppliers, and ensuring adherence to County procurement procedures and audit requirements.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Essential Functions***

The duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not necessarily limited to:

* Provide comprehensive administrative support, including scheduling, recordkeeping, mail processing, document preparation, and filing to ensure smooth department operations.
* Maintain organized electronic and physical files, and manage department logs, trackers, and routine reports.
* Assist with contract intake, tracking, routing for review and approval, and maintain complete and accurate contract files.
* Monitor workflow milestones and provide timely status updates to staff and stakeholders.
* Serve as a backup Buyer and prepare and submit requisitions and purchase orders in the County ERP system.
* Coordinate supplier communications for quote requests, confirmations, delivery follow ‑ ups, and assist in routine purchasing decisions in alignment with County procurement procedures.
* Resolve routine procurement issues such as documentation gaps, purchase order modifications or cancellations, receiving updates, and support audit readiness by ensuring complete and compliant records.
* Ensure compliance with County procurement policies, contract administration procedures, records retention standards, and audit requirements.
* Assist with drafting, updating, and organizing department standard operating procedures.
* Support responses to Right to Know Requests.
* Communicate professionally with internal departments and vendors to facilitate timely, accurate information sharing and issue resolution.
* Provide logistics support and assist with special projects as assigned by the Director and/or Deputy Director.

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Associate’s Degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, or closely related subject.
* Four years of experience in advanced administrative office experience.
* Any equivalent combination of experience and training which provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.

**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrate strong organizational and follow ‑ through skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and complete assignments independently.
* Detail oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems for requisitions, purchase orders, receiving, and reporting, or a strong willingness and ability to learn.
* Analytical thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to interpret and consistently apply basic procurement procedures.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the ability to produce clear, accurate documents and spreadsheets.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, along with strong interpersonal abilities to build effective working relationships with staff, County departments, vendors, and the public.
* High ethical standards and a commitment to confidentiality.
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions with precision and initiative.
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage time effectively.
* Ability to handle stress.
* Physical presence in the office is required.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

Work involves standing, walking, sitting, lifting, carrying, talking, hearing, and reaching with hands and arms. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds a distance of 15 feet or less.

**WORKING ENVIRONMENT:**

Normal cubicles and individual office environment. Work is primarily performed during regular business hours; however, occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on the department’s needs. Travel within the assigned service area may be required. The position may require working in moderately noisy to loud environments, including cubicles and communal workspaces, and participating in frequent collaborative team meetings. The work environment may include a fast-paced setting with frequent interruptions, changing priorities, and interactions with employees, the public, and other stakeholders.

**Position Overview:**

The Procurement Assistant plays a vital role in supporting the procurement activities of the Elections Division within the County Clerk’s Office. This position is responsible for assisting with the purchasing of goods and services, ensuring compliance with Harris County purchasing policies and procedures, and providing efficient support to all departmental procurement needs.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Create, review, and submit requisitions for approval through Harris County Purchasing, and forward approved purchase orders to vendors.
* Process invoices and payments to vendors for services rendered.
* Maintain inventory levels and a working knowledge of all office assets, both capital and non-capital.
* Obtain quotes from suppliers to support the processing of order requests.
* Process supply orders and service requests submitted by department heads.
* Communicate with new vendors to obtain required documentation for creating a Supplier ID in STARS and forward all materials to Harris County Purchasing.
* Assist Harris County Purchasing with the inspection of capital asset inventory.
* Manage surplus inventory.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

----------------

**Must meet all eligibility requirements to register to vote in the State of Texas.**

* High School Diploma or G.E.D. equivalent from an accredited educational institution **with**
* Two (2) years of related experience

**OR**

* An Associate degree in a related field.

**PLUS**

* Two (2) years of experience using any ERP financial system.
* Two (2) years of experience performing clerical, administrative, or fiscal work.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and related functions.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Ability to prioritize work assignments.
* Ability to process transactions and perform accounting duties such as account maintenance, recording entries, and reconciling accounts.
* Exceptional customer service skills.
* Ability to manage projects from start to finish.
* Ability to meet strict processing deadlines.
* Ability to analyze data to track ordering and spending patterns.
* Strong judgment and decision-making skills.
* Strong leadership and communication skills.
* Detail-oriented.

* Experience in a fast-paced environment.

-----------------------

Signet Jewelers is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry, operating more than 2,800 stores worldwide under the iconic brands: Kay Jewelers, Zales, Jared, H.Samuel, Ernest Jones, Peoples, Banter by Piercing Pagoda, Rocksbox, JamesAllen.com and Diamonds Direct. We are a people-first company and this core value is at the heart of everything we do, from empowering our valued team members, to collaborating with our customers, to fostering the communities in which we live and serve. People – and the love their actions inspire – are what drive us. We’re not only proud of the love we inspire outside our walls, we’re especially proud of the diversity, inclusion and equity we’re inspiring inside. There are dynamic career paths awaiting you – rewarding opportunities to impact the lives of others and inspire love. Join us!

The primary responsibility of the Assistant Buyer is to assist their Buyer on all aspects of the job or step in as needed to help with Merchandise Coordinator/Detail Assistant duties. They are responsible for sourcing and developing product, pricing product, determining assortment groups, forecasting order quantities, and participating in competitive shops. Weekly reporting and departmental reports.

**Product Development**

* Develop understanding/knowledge base of the Jewelry Category
* Work with the Buyer to learn the elements of merchandising as it applies to their position.
* Overall understanding and maintenance of their merchandise category, in conjunction with the Buyer
* Identify sales trends, develop new product designs for testing and assortment opportunities
* Attend vendor meetings and actively participate in selection and review of product. Be the point person for meeting notes and follow-up.
* Instrumental in determining various marketing vehicles, SKU selection, new merchandise programs, sales trends, and assortments which lead to sales growth and overall productivity in their area.
* Be jointly accountable for the success of their specific merchandise category with regards to sales, inventory levels & gross margin goals, which are established by Management.
* Participate in on-going Competitive Shopping from an omni-channel lens. Review our assortments as well as competitor to ascertain opportunities and advantages.
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing market trends, conditions, priorities, and corporate strategies.

**Assortment / Inventory Management**

* Setup sku’s, descriptions, retails and packaging attributes.
* Assist Buyer with Assortment Development - Work with Planners and Inventory Analysts to set program parameters (i.e. product attributes, assortment size, targeted inventory and turn levels, open-to-buy requirements)
* Monitor and help develop forecasted sales quantities for marketing items and new programs in conjunction with the Inventory Analyst and Buyer
* Communicate and manage with vendors re: product qualities, costs, terms/ownership, delivery dates, return of merchandise requests.
* Establish retail prices in line with margin requirements
* Responsible for updating departmental category assortment sheets, reporting, and analysis

**Collaboration**

* Proofing of all advertising materials to ensure accuracy including catalogs, emails, web site, customer mailings, and in store signage.
* Merchandise items for all marketing channels, which are innovative and competitive within the marketplace.
* Attend open-to-buy meetings and provide merchandise status updates as needed
* Complete and submit Project Request Forms and develop store communications.
* Work in collaboration with Visual Merchandising team for in-store presentations (planograms).

description:
**Job Overview**

As an entry-level Purchasing Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting the purchasing and procurement process by coordinating purchase orders, communicating with vendors, tracking inventory, and following up on deliveries. Your attention to detail and organizational skills will help ensure materials, supplies, and services are purchased accurately and delivered on time. You will work closely with vendors, accounting, warehouse, production, and management teams to maintain efficient purchasing operations. This role requires strong communication skills, proficiency with Microsoft Excel, accuracy, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Hours** Monday–Friday – Business Hours

**Pay Range:** $18.00 – $22.00/hour

*Expected Annual Salary: $37,440 – $45,760 per year*

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Location:** Troy, IL

**Responsibilities**

* Create, issue, and track purchase orders and purchasing requisitions according to company requirements.
* Research suppliers, request quotations (RFQs), compare pricing, and assist with negotiating basic purchasing terms.

**Description**

**Salaried Non Exempt**
**Position Title:** Purchasing Assistant Warehouse 12 hour Rotating from 6am to 6pm
**Department:** Purchasing Department

**Location:** Plainwell Plant

**Purchasing Assistant**—Serves under Purchasing Supervisor

The primary responsibilities of the Purchasing Assistant are turning purchase orders from released requisitions, confirm pricing and delivery dates on purchase orders with vendors, build relationships with vendors and assisting the Purchasing Supervisor with their duties.
**Responsibilities:**
Responsible for all aspects of the purchase order cycle to include:

* Checking requisitions for accurate information and internal releases.
* Acquiring pricing and delivery date confirmation from vendors.
* Contacting vendors when deliveries are late or incomplete. Will require coordination with Packaging and Stock Room Departments.
* Assisting vendors with any questions or problems they may have in regards to purchase orders
* Working with accounting to ensure that purchase orders have been received and invoices posted.
* Working with Accounts Payable to check payment status/problems for vendor invoices.
* All other duties as assigned by Purchasing Manager or Controller

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**
The Knowledge of overseeing all functions involved in incoming receiving inspection and accurately processing the inventory changes to Maintenance Parts, Operating Supplies, Ingredients, and Packaging supplies. This person will work closely with other departments within the Plainwell Complex to insure materials are received to the correct department and personnel.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Finding parts and materials in the computer data base for maintenance and other departments.
* + Checking on hand computer balances.
+ Finding locations and warehouses where parts are stored.
+ Researching Order histories including the following:
+ - On order quantities
- Requisitions and details including for whom the materials were ordered.
- Receiving histories.
- Issue histories.
- Return and repair histories.

* Two to five years purchasing/procurement experience.
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Good math skills.
* Good organizational skills.
* Computer skills to include Microsoft Office Suite Programs (Outlook, Word, Excel and some knowledge of Access).
* SAP experience preferred
* Minimum one-year experience in procurement, inventory control, asset management, or incoming inspection and receiving.

**EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS**:

High School Diploma/GED; College Degree in business related preferred

**EOE/INCLUDING DISABILITY/VETS**

* Maintains a supply chain that minimizes inventory while maintaining product availability.
* Maintains adequate inventories of purchased and manufactured material to satisfy the company.
* Collaborates with internal departments, receiving, and accounting on a regular basis.
* Contributes to process improvement within LogistiQ with strategic alignment with the overall business plan and focus of the company.
* Other duties as assigned

* None.

* This position may require occasional travel.

* Basic math skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division).

Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented individual with a passion for retail, consumer behavior, and data analysis.

* Evaluate assortment performance and provide recommendations on product selection, depth, market allocation, replenishment, and inventory positioning
* Prepare for and participate in product meetings and assortment reviews (Style Out)
* Maintain assortment planning tools and business processes that support buying and merchandising decisions
* Recommend pricing adjustments, including markdowns, for stores and e-commerce based on market conditions, product performance, and inventory levels
* Work on ad hoc business analyses and special projects aligned with strategic merchandising objectives

**Business Analysis, Reporting & Communication**

* Compile, review, and interpret weekly and seasonal sales and inventory reports to identify trends, opportunities, and key performance indicators
* Prepare clear business analyses and presentations that summarize findings, highlight risks and opportunities, and support decision-making
* Develop and maintain reporting tools and dashboards used by the Buying team
* Prepare materials and provide support for business reviews, key initiatives, collaborations, and internal meetings
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Planning, Allocation, Product, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, and other teams; contribute relevant analysis and recommendations in cross-functional discussion
* Partner with international and franchise partners to gather business information, understand market needs, and support execution of approved merchandising strategies

**Order Management, Systems & Other Responsibilities**

* Assist with the execution of purchase orders based on approved assortment and buying strategies, including style setup, product classification, and maintenance of accurate product data
* Generate, maintain, and monitor purchase orders from creation through delivery, flagging potential delays, discrepancies, or inventory risks

* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned
* Stay current on retail industry trends, consumer behavior, competitive activity, and international market dynamics relevant to assigned brands and markets

* Ability to analyze information, identify trends and opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to work with minimal supervision
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication, collaboration, and follow-through skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and international business partners

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Buying & Merchandising, Retail Management, or a related field preferred

description:
**Take Ownership of Your Career and Shape Your Future!**

Are you ready to become an Employee Owner? At Suburban Enterprises, you not only work for the company you own the company! The ideal candidate is happy where he/she is currently employed but is interested in a more self-directed work environment, increased responsibility, and the opportunity to grow into additional roles. We would like to hire someone interested in a career, not a job, who wants to do the work and be recognized for a job well done!

**The Role – Purchasing Assistant**

The Purchasing Assistant provides administrative and operational support to the Purchasing team by maintaining accurate purchasing records, monitoring orders, coordinating inventory transactions, resolving supplier and invoice issues. This role plays a key part in ensuring timely procurement, accurate inventory management, and effective communication between suppliers, purchasing, accounts payable, and internal stakeholders.

**What You'll Do**

* Enter and maintain accurate order, purchasing, and inventory data in company systems.
* Process order acknowledgements and review to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Process inventory requests related to field and machine moves.
* Monitor and maintain accurate inventory records.
* Track supplier shipments and follow up on purchase orders to ensure timely delivery.
* Coordinate material returns and ensure timely pickup and credit processing.
* Partner with Accounts Payable to investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies.
* Assist with supplier performance evaluations.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation for all quoting projects.
* Support Purchasing team as needed to ensure efficient operations.

**What You Bring (Required Experience)**

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required
* 1-3 years of purchasing experience and/or training
* Familiarity with ERP and/or inventory software
* Experience in the use of a PC and Microsoft Word and Excel software, as well as the Internet

**Bonus Points For (Preferred Experience)**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain or related field preferred

**What We Offer – Why Choose Suburban Enterprises?**

* **Team Member Ownership**: Work for a company where your contributions directly impact your future

* **Commitment to Safety**: Safety isn’t just a priority; it’s our promise to you and your family

* **Career Growth**: This isn't just a job - it's a career path with opportunities for advancement
* **Continuous Learning**: Investment in your professional development
* **Collaborative Culture**: Work with a team that values respect, integrity, and excellence

* **Comprehensive Benefits**: Competitive pay, ESOP, 401(K) with employer match, and no healthcare premium increases for 4 years

**Ready to Join Us?**

Our high standards of service to our customers and clients require that we select only the top team members based on our culture and core values so please read and understand them or come with clarifying questions because we work, live, hire and promote by them. We will choose new team members with great care because the future of Suburban Enterprises rests with them. You are here because we believe in your character and abilities.

If you're passionate about innovation, committed to excellence, and ready to be part of a company that invests in its people, we want to hear from you. Help us create a better future through innovation and automation.

*We are an equal opportunity employer.*

At Ben E. Keith Company, our legacy is strong—and our future is even stronger.

For more than a century, we’ve been leaders in fine food and premium beverage distribution, known for delivering excellence and building lasting partnerships. Today, our Food Division spans multiple states, and our Beverage Division brings top beverage brands to communities across Texas.

But what truly sets us apart is our commitment to people. We invest in our employees, empower growth, and create opportunities to make an impact—because when our people succeed, so do our customers and our business. Since 1906, that’s been our promise.

The Purchasing Assistant will compile information and records to draw up purchase orders for procurement of materials and services. The Purchasing Assistant will select, order and authorize payment for merchandise according to contractual agreements.

* Represent Ben E. Keith Company with professionalism, maintain a positive attitude and follow dress code
* Prepare purchase orders - send copies to suppliers and to departments originating requests.
* Determine if inventory quantities are sufficient for needs, ordering more materials when necessary.
* Respond to customer and supplier inquiries about order status, changes, or cancellations.
* Perform buying duties when necessary.
* Contact suppliers in order to schedule or expedite deliveries and to resolve shortages, missed or late deliveries, and other problems.
* Review requisition orders in order to verify accuracy, terminology and specifications.
* Prepare, maintain and review purchasing files, reports and price lists.
* Compare prices, specifications and delivery dates in order to determine the best bid among potential suppliers.
* Track the status of requisitions, contracts and orders.
* Calculate costs of orders and charge or forward invoices to appropriate accounts.
* Check shipments when they arrive to ensure that orders have been filled correctly and those goods meet specifications.
* Approve bills for payment.
* Locate suppliers using sources such as catalogs and the internet, interview supplier about products for ordering.
* Special projects as assigned.

**Job Qualifications:**

* 2 to 5 years Marketing or Purchasing experience preferred.
* Valid Driver’s license – Required to perform company business
* Knowledge and ability to competently us MS Office, internet and email – willingness to learn new software as needed.
* Associates or related degree /related experience resulting in equivalent level of knowledge and experience is required.

We offer employees the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in collaborative, results-driven environments supported by competitive benefits, including:

* Medical, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance
* 401(k) with Company Match + 100% Company-Paid Profit Sharing
* Paid Time Off & Holidays
* Wellness, EAP & Educational Assistance

At Ben E. Keith, we value a diverse and inclusive workforce where different perspectives drive better decisions and innovation. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor, considering all qualified applicants, including minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

description:
Contech Engineered Solutions LLC provides site solutions for engineers, contractors, architects, and owners. The Contech portfolio includes bridges, drainage, erosion control, retaining wall, sanitary sewer, and stormwater management products. Through cost-effective engineered solutions, we help build, support, and sustain land development projects while protecting the environment.

**The Position**

Contech Engineered Solutions seeks a detail-oriented and dependable **Assistant Buyer** to join our team in West Chester, Ohio - **LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY**. In this role, you’ll provide essential administrative and clerical support to the Purchasing Department, helping keep day-to-day purchasing activities running smoothly. Working closely with Buyers and the Department Manager, you’ll maintain accurate purchasing records and data while supporting our plants and vendors with routine requests, information, and coordination.

**Why Should You Apply?**

At Contech Engineered Solutions, you’ll be part of a team-oriented environment where collaboration, innovation, and shared success are a priority. As an industry leader in world-class design, manufacturing, sourcing, and distribution, we provide opportunities to work alongside talented professionals and contribute to meaningful work. We’re also committed to helping our employees achieve their professional goals while maintaining a healthy balance between work and life.

**About the Role**

* Request written bids and telephone quotes from approved vendors as directed, and record bid information including vendor price, payment terms, and delivery.
* Respond to and process system triggers for material and requests from plants for material or information; escalate issues to a Buyer as needed and communicate order status and delivery expectations to internal customers while coordinating with Contech Logistics.
* Prepare and issue Purchase Orders for raw material within established guidelines and as directed by a Buyer.
* Monitor on-hand inventory of stock at supplier, subcontractor and plant locations and report discrepancies and assist with physical inventory.
* Assist with tracking vendor quality and delivery issues and prepare supporting documentation for claims as directed.
* Support accounting and purchasing functions, including receiving products, virtually transferring inventory, reviewing invoices and obtaining proof of delivery documents from vendors.
* Communicate with vendors to obtain product, pricing and delivery information; refer vendor concerns and emergency purchase needs to a Buyer or the Manager.
* Maintain accurate purchasing files and records using proper record keeping methods and procedures.
* Follow departmental purchasing policies and procedures; refer questions on specifications, including AASHTO and ASTM requirements, and other regulations to a Buyer or the Manager.
* Assist with monitoring data integrity in the ERP system, incoming EDI data and Access databases; identify errors and assist with resolution.
* Assist with entering new items and new item/plant combinations into the ERP system in coordination with Cost Accounting, ensuring accurate descriptions are loaded.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Associate’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of six months to one year of office, clerical, or purchasing experience.
* Attention to detail in reviewing purchasing documents such as invoices, purchase orders, and requisitions to ensure conformance with policies and procedures.
* Basic knowledge of office procedures and general computer applications used in business, such as spreadsheet, database, and word processing software. Willingness to learn purchasing practices, including ethics, standards, bid preparation and competitive bidding procedures.
* Ability to: collect and enter data accurately; perform arithmetic calculations; use common units of measure; calculate discounts and shipping charges; prepare basic written reports; recognize responsibility and limits of assigned authority; maintain effective working relationships with vendors, management personnel, and co-workers.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* Ability to travel occasionally.
* Familiarity with J.D. Edwards or another ERP system.

**Ready to Apply?**

The process is simple. Click on the “apply” button to get started. Good luck!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identification, transgender status, national origin, protected veteran status, or status as an individual with a disability. description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The incumbent will assist the Production Staff Manager in providing professional direction to the management group on purchasing strategies. The position will ensure that Corporate policies and procedures in the purchasing area are effectively implemented. The incumbent will assist in long range planning, value analysis and setting cost-saving goals, including supervises inventory levels. Buyer manages all vendor managed inventory in the warehouse, maintaining correct minimum/maximum levels.

**SCOPE AND IMPACT OF THE POSITION**

The success of the purchasing activity is directly related to the profitability of the Company. Because this position is called upon for advice, individual credibility is of the utmost importance. This position requires interfacing with Company employees’ company-wide, as well as outside vendors, thus necessitating effective communication capabilities both written and oral.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Performs all purchasing functions including evaluation per manager implemented procedures.
* Establishes and maintains effective relationships with Vendors as a primary Company representative.
* Purchases hardware, MRO, safety supplies, miscellaneous shop supplies, Exceedra materials, Costco/janitorial and kitchen needs, along with managing most company credit card purchases.
* Uses appropriate judgment and integrity in all purchasing decisions and establishes a high standard of conduct.
* Receives Purchase Requisitions from Project Managers, Plant Engineers, Foremen and other Company personnel. Obtains pricing and lead time information as necessary to make informed and cost-effective purchasing decisions. Issues Purchase Orders as necessary for securing requisitioned materials, equipment or services and inventory. Responsible for expediting all orders as required for timely delivery.
* Coordinates incoming traffic of major materials and adds big deliveries to delivery calendar.
* Maintains supplier/manufacturer library and updates as required. Maintains computer vendor database.
* Stamps, reviews, and processes all certification documents received from buyers, ensuring records are accurate and properly maintained.
* Tool Watch administrative help (Load Parts, Employee Information, ext.)
* Support the Warehouse by assisting in the write ups for BOL'S for shipping
* Process new SOS sheets for new product purchases.
* Assist in tracking Warehouse repair items.
* Assists Accounting in reconciling vendor invoices as required.

**SPECIAL NOTES AND CONDITIONS**

* (Outside work, travel, exceptional hours, etc.)
* Some work may require presence in the concrete manufacturing plant.
* Location is at CTC’s premises, except for local travel as required in support of customers. CTC does not offer telecommuting.

**COMPANY BENEFITS**

* Competitive salary: $26.78 - $28.50 per hour depending on experience
* Healthcare Coverage - Medical, dental, and vision with family coverage included
* Retirement plan - 401(k) with generous company matching and an employer sponsored money purchase pension plan.
* Paid time off - Holidays, vacation and sick leave

**Education/Experience**

· One to two years of progressive experience in purchasing and inventory management (experience in Construction-related field preferred).

**Skills**

* Knowledge of Microsoft word, Excel, Outlook
* Knowledge of Sage computer software
* Ability to Multitask
* Good attention to detail
* Great Team Member
* Positive attitude & customer service skills
* Strength in Problem Solving
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to bridge communication gap between technical terms and general management knowledge.
* Strong mathematical skills.

**Benefits**

* Medical insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Life insurance
* State parental leave
* Employee assistant program
* Health savings account
* HSA online store with great prices
* 7 paid holidays
* Accrued paid time off
* State accrued sick pay
* 401(k) matching after 1 year of service
* Retirement plan
* Professional development assistance when job-related

description:
Big R is looking to hire an Assistant Buyer to provide support to our Sporting Goods/Automotive departments. An Assistant Buyer is responsible for providing operational support to the Buyer with a focus on business management and problem-solving. They are committed to executing responsibilities and managing functions for a product category. They will develop an understanding of the company’s business and position in the market, evolving into an expert in a business category, and working with vendors, agents, and other suppliers. The Assistant Buyer should have a proven ability to multi-task and operate independently, with strong presentation, communication, and Excel skills.

* + This is not a remote position; all work is done from Big R’s home office in Pueblo, CO.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform operational functions supporting buyer to achieve sales, margin and inventory plans
* Write purchase orders and manage the purchase order process with suppliers ensuring on time and accurate delivery
* Demonstrate advanced product knowledge by sharing information with buyer through competitive shopping and market trend research
* Independently identify priorities and proactively work to achieve efficiency in purchase order writing, item maintenance and administrative tasks
* Establish and maintain a reputation of responsiveness in the marketplace
* Troubleshoot issues and negotiate with suppliers accordingly
* Utilize various software applications daily

* Professional attitude and appearance
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills
* Ability to maintain focus on goals and objectives that deliver results
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Great communicator who works best in a collaborative environment and builds mutual trust and credibility at all levels of an organization
* Ability to apply new practices in a constantly changing environment
* High school diploma

To apply for this position, please click here. Only applicants with resumes attached will be considered.

* Starting wage is based on experience.

Benefits:

* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance Options (Eligibility required)
* 401K Retirement Plan Options (Eligibility required)
* Employee Discount
* Paid Holidays
* On-site Gym
* Advancement opportunities
