Starts at $18.29/hour
5% targeted monthly bonus.

Insurance benefits start day 1.

80 hours vacation after 90 days.
On-the-job training with career growth opportunities.

The Doe Run Company is currently seeking an Assistant Buyer to support purchasing and warehouse teams by generating purchase orders for stock material, managing replenishment and placing direct purchase orders as required. This dayshift position is located at Central Office located in Viburnum, MO.

The work location may change as needed to support production and business needs within the Viburnum Trend in Southeast Missouri.

**Education & Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum 1 year customer service experience

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Proficient computer skills utilizing Microsoft Office (Word & Excel) and ERP (PeopleSoft).
* Positive customer service and communication skills.
* Basic organization skills to support filing needs.
* Time management skills to complete tasks timely.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Issue all basic stock orders
* Print and distribute requisitions.
* Manage stock replenishment.
* All required document filing.
* Manage direct requisitions as required for assigned locations, includes quoting material as required.
* Complete tasks in a safe and environmentally compliant manner by following EHS (environmental, health and safety) policies, procedures and best practices; support and assist peers in working in a safe, compliant manner; report unsafe acts or conditions, incidents, and deviations; and provide feedback to support continuous improvement in EHS performance.
* Other duties or projects as assigned.

**Work Environment, Physical & Lifting Requirements:**

* Regular use of a computer and telephone.
* Work is regularly performed in a standard quiet office setting.
* Regularly sitting and repetitive wrist and/or finger movement, frequently hearing, occasionally talking and standing, and rarely reaching with arms and/or hands. Requires clarity of vision at 20 inches or less and concentrated attention.
* Frequently required to lift up to 5 pounds and rarely lift up to 15 pounds.

Based in St. Louis, Missouri, USA, The Doe Run Company is a privately held natural resources company and a global provider of lead, copper, and zinc concentrates. Dedicated to environmentally responsible mineral and metal production, Doe Run operates the Resource Recycling facility, one of the world’s largest, single-site lead recycling centers, located in Boss, Missouri. The company also owns six operating mines in one of the world’s largest lead mining districts, also in Missouri: Brushy Creek, Buick, Casteel, Fletcher/West Fork, Mine 29/Viburnum and Sweetwater. The Doe Run Company and its subsidiaries deliver products and services necessary to provide power, protection, and convenience. Doe Run has operations in Missouri, Washington, and Arizona. For more information, visit www.doerun.com (http://www.doerun.com/).

All job offers are contingent upon the candidate's successful completion and clearance of post-offer drug screen, physical, and background check. Background checks include verification of education, employment history, and criminal record review. The role may also require a motor vehicle record review and ATF explosives possessor clearance.

Doe Run is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and veterans.

#### **Experience**

Required

* 1 year(s): Customer Service Experience

#### **Education**

Required

* High School or better

We are a growing manufacturing company seeking an organized, proactive Buyer / Purchasing Coordinator to support daily purchasing and keep materials on schedule. This role focuses on purchasing specified parts from established or customer-designated suppliers, confirming pricing and availability, issuing purchase orders, and following up delivery.

You will work from provided part numbers, purchasing lists, and supplier information, including projects with approximately 200–300 BOM part numbers. Success requires accuracy, consistent follow-up, and clear communication with suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Request supplier quotations and confirm part numbers, quantities, pricing, stock availability, lead times, and purchasing terms.
* Compare quotations for specified items and obtain internal approvals before ordering.
* Create and issue accurate purchase orders and obtain supplier order acknowledgments.
* Track open orders, promised ship dates, and expected arrival dates; follow up regularly until receipt.
* Identify shortages, missed commitments, and delivery risks early; coordinate expediting and escalate issues with clear status and proposed next steps.
* Communicate with customers to clarify designated suppliers, customer-allocated purchasing arrangements, and other purchasing instructions.
* Maintain an accurate Excel or purchasing-system tracker showing order status, quantities, supplier commitments, and outstanding issues.
* Coordinate with production, receiving, and accounting to resolve quantity, delivery, and invoice discrepancies.
* Keep supplier quotations, approvals, purchase orders, and correspondence organized and current.

**Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of experience in purchasing, order management, or supplier coordination; manufacturing or industrial experience preferred.
* Experience requesting quotations, processing purchase orders, and following up with suppliers.
* Working proficiency in Excel, including sorting, filtering, and maintaining detailed tracking sheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for supplier and customer correspondence.
* Strong attention to detail, especially with part numbers, quantities, prices, and dates.
* Ability to prioritize multiple orders, follow up proactively, and communicate problems promptly.
* Comfortable working with project managers to support their purchasing needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience purchasing electrical or mechanical components.
* Familiarity with supplier lead times, minimum order quantities, and order acknowledgments.

**Role Scope**

Part specifications and approved supplier information are provided. Technical interpretation of BOMs, engineering design, and technical selection of substitute products are handled by the project managers or customer contact. The Buyer confirms purchasing details and routes technical questions for approval.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Purchase orders and tracking records are accurate and current.
* Supplier commitments are confirmed and followed up consistently.
* Delivery risks are reported early enough for the team to respond.
* Purchasing follows customer requirements and internal approvals.

Pay: $22.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

* Strong computer and data entry skills.

* Full time- Monday - Friday, 8 AM - 5 PM

Description:

**Produce Assistant Buyer & Receiver**

**Part-time; benefits eligible**

**Friday - Saturday 6:00am - 2:00pm**

**16 Hours**

**Purpose: Support the Produce Buyer in meeting department goals by assisting with buying and receiving.**

**Status: Reports to Produce Manager**

**Pay Level 3**

**Responsibilities:**

**General:**

* Follow all department policies and procedures in order for Hunger Mountain Co-op to adhere to all applicable regulations.
* Be responsible for safety in the workplace by creating a safe work environment, reporting safety concerns to a manager, and adhering to all safety rules and regulations.
* Be a team player.
* Attend all required meetings, training, seminars and workshops.

**Buying:**

* Fill in and assist buyer and place day-to-day orders with established suppliers within guidelines set by Produce Manager.
* Inventory back stock to determine ordering needs and for periodic financial reporting.
* Communicate daily with Produce buyer regarding market choices and opportunities.
* Enter new products in the Point of Sale (POS) system, as needed.
* Assist in updating, organizing, and maintaining sales data in department spreadsheet.
* Assist in making and maintaining price signs and making price changes in POS system in consultation or at the direction of the Produce Buyer and/or Manager.
* Regularly double check floor pricing to assure consistency with the POS.
* Notify Produce buyer of inconsistencies in pricing and reports.
* Obtain credit from suppliers, as needed.

**Receiving:**

* Receive deliveries following established procedures, checking for quality and accuracy, while maintaining proper product rotation.
* Follow appropriate procedures for handling invoices.
* Maintain a clean and safe work environment, including mopping floors and cleaning cooler shelves.

**Merchandising:**

* Assist with displays following guidelines of Produce Manager. Replenish and rotate displays as needed; assure accuracy of signage; label items with PLU stickers and/or signs; correct pricing discrepancies and report to Produce Manager.
* Inform floor staff of new products when they arrive and facilitate the stocking and labelling of any new items.
* Assist floor staff with replenishing and maintaining displays, culling several times daily, and following stocking priorities set by Produce Manager.
* Assist customers with produce and special orders; offer samples and suggestions for purchases and preparations in friendly, courteous manner.
* Trim, wash, and prepare produce as needed. Pull damaged or spoiled items and dispose with appropriate notification to Produce Manager.
* Assist with general produce maintenance as needed. Remove trash, clean cases and mirrors, and keep prep and storage areas in clean, orderly condition.
* Use equipment safely. Monitor cooler and walk-in temperatures and follow procedures for handling breakdowns. Advise Produce Manager of equipment repair and replacement needs.

**Miscellaneous:**

* Provide produce information and education to Co-op staff members and customers.
* Participate in periodic inventory.
* Attend department and storewide meetings.
* Perform other tasks assigned by Produce Manager.

Requirements:

The responsibilities as listed in this job description are representative only and not exhaustive of the tasks that an employee may be required to perform. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**Qualifications:**

* Prior retail produce experience required; experience with produce purchasing, merchandising, quality control, organic standards and especially ordering and working with multiple local organic farms is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to follow through on commitments under tight time pressures.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented with a strong numerical aptitude.
* Ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks.
* Familiarity with computers and Microsoft Office including use of Excel.
* Experience working in a fast-paced environment involving frequently lifting 50 lbs., standing for long periods, and working in a cold environment.
* Manual dexterity with equipment used in moving, unpacking and preparing produce for display.
* Ability to follow all Safety policies and procedures of Hunger Mountain Co-op.
* Ability to provide excellent service to customers, vendors and co-workers and abide by Hunger Mountain Co-op’s Service Policies.
* Ability to work well with others in a cooperative environment where teamwork and constant communication are essential.

**Desired:**

* Ability to have some scheduling flexibility with when business needs require it.
* Ability to follow attendance and punctuality policies of Hunger Mountain Co-op.
* Ability to be physically present onsite at the Co-op to perform the requirements of this position.

description:
The Specialist, Procurement is responsible for executing procurement activities in support of defense and aerospace programs, including the acquisition of raw materials, components, assemblies, equipment, and services necessary to meet program, production, and customer requirements. This role applies professional procurement knowledge to support supplier selection, pricing analysis, purchase order administration, and supplier performance management while ensuring alignment with quality, cost, delivery, and compliance objectives. The position works under general supervision and contributes to operational and program success through effective sourcing, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team supporting complex programs in a highly regulated environment.

**Essential Functions:**

* Plans and executes procurement activities for raw materials, components, equipment, and services in support of defense and aerospace program requirements.
* Solicits, reviews, and analyzes supplier quotations, proposals, and bids to support sourcing decisions and cost objectives.
* Negotiates pricing, terms and conditions, and delivery commitments in accordance with company policies and program requirements.
* Issues and administers purchase orders through completion, including management of acknowledgements, deliveries, invoice discrepancies, and order closeout.
* Evaluates supplier capability, performance, and risk related to quality, cost, schedule, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinates with internal stakeholders including engineering, manufacturing, quality, program management, and finance to ensure procurement actions support technical and contractual requirements.
* Resolves supplier-related issues involving shortages, damages, returns, over-shipments, cancellations, and engineering or configuration changes.
* Maintains accurate procurement records and supports audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and reporting requirements.
* Reviews market conditions, supplier trends, and pricing data to recommend sourcing strategies and process improvements.
* Ensures procurement activities are conducted in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual requirements, anti-corruption standards, and ethical business practices.
* May provide guidance, coaching, or day-to-day support to less experienced employees within the job area
* Travel up to 20% may be required.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant procurement experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related procurement experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related procurement experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience supporting defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) requirements.
* Experience procuring electronic components, mechanical parts, complex assemblies, or specialized services.
* Familiarity with supplier performance management, cost analysis, and schedule risk mitigation.
* Experience supporting engineering change activity, configuration changes, and material returns.
* Working knowledge of export compliance considerations, including International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
* Experience using material requirements planning or enterprise resource planning tools in a production or program environment.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Washington, and the Greater D.C. area, Denver, or NYC areas is $79,000.00 - $147,000.00. The salary range for this role in Colorado state, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Minnesota, New York state, Cleveland Ohio, Vermont and Virginia is $69,500.00 - $128,500.00 This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

description:
**Stevens Creek Hyundai**, a proud member of the DGDG family, is looking for talented sales professionals to join their team. If you are looking for an exciting career with one of the top workplaces in the Bay Area - apply today! DGDG’s vision for success is driven by our unique culture and cutting-edge technology. To make our vision real, we look for sales professionals who think differently and strive to provide 100% guest satisfaction. We provide top-notch training to ensure your success and are proud to offer all our Sales team members one weekend off a month.

As a **Used Car Buyer/Trade In Specialist**, you are responsible for following up with leads and creating valuable guest experience for customers wanting to sell or trade in their vehicles.

**What you’ll be working on:**

* Reaching out to customers who have expressed interest in selling or trading in their vehicle
* Following up on inbound leads through phone, email, or text to gather vehicle info and set appointments
* Communicating regularly with customers to understand their needs and offer a competitive, fair-value deal
* Logging outreach and customer status updates in the CRM system
* Partnering with General Managers and Used Car Managers to understand inventory needs and source accordingly
* Occasionally attending car auctions to scout vehicle opportunities and support store-level buying goals

**What you need to bring to the table:**

* 1-3 years of customer service, retail, or sales experience
* Strong communication skills—both in person and over the phone
* Confidence in negotiating and guiding customers through the vehicle trade-in or selling process is a plus
* Ability to stay organized, follow up consistently, and work independently
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record

**Salary:** $36,000-$150,000/annually

* Pay is based on applicable experience and skills. This job is eligible for commissions based on individual sales metrics.

**Industry Leading Benefits:**

* Values-driven culture and team built on integrity, caring, performance and efficiency
* Continuous career development and advancement opportunities
* Comprehensive benefits package (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* 401k with company match
* Employee Assistance Program with free telemedicine and mental health resources
* Exclusive Employee Vehicle Purchase Program with a 3-Year Service Maintenance Package

**More about DGDG:**

The Del Grande Dealer Group (DGDG) is the largest family-owned automotive group in the Bay Area. Our team is over 1,000 strong and growing. We’ve been named a Bay Area News Group Top Workplace for 16 consecutive years (not to mention being named a Top Workplace USA in 2020). Our enthusiastic and courteous team, award-winning culture, combined with our cutting-edge technology, provide guests with a one-of-a-kind, “best-in-class\\" dealership experience.

DGDG's 4 core values of Integrity, Caring, Performance, and Efficiency have stood at the cornerstone of our success. Our shared passion for training, teaching, recognition, reward, and promotion produce results that set us apart.

“Be happy” is much more than a slogan. It’s a way of doing business. We pride ourselves on making our guests and our team members exceedingly happy. And we’d be happy if you joined us!

DGDG takes your privacy seriously. You can learn more here: DGDG Privacy Policy\\*.

We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination/harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
